```python
class SchedulerEngine:
    """Post scheduling engine"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.running = False
        self.check_interval = 60  # Check every 60 seconds
    
    async def start(self):
        """Start the scheduler engine"""
        
        self.running = True
        
        while self.running:
            try:
                await self._process_due_posts()
                await asyncio.sleep(self.check_interval)
            except Exception as e:
                log_error(f"Scheduler error: {e}")
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
    
    async def stop(self):
        """Stop the scheduler engine"""
        self.running = False
    
    async def _process_due_posts(self):
        """Process all posts that are due for publishing"""
        
        now = datetime.now(pytz.UTC)
        
        # Get all scheduled posts that are due
        due_posts = get_due_posts(now)
        
        for post in due_posts:
            # Mark as publishing
            update_post_status(post.id, PostStatus.PUBLISHING)
            
            # Publish to each platform
            results = {}
            
            for platform in post.platforms:
                account = get_user_account(post.user_id, platform)
                
                if not account:
                    results[platform.value] = PublishResult(
                        platform=platform,
                        success=False,
                        post_id="",
                        post_url="",
                        error_message="Account not connected",
                        published_at=now
                    )
                    continue
                
                try:
                    publisher = get_publisher(account)
                    result = await publisher.publish_post(
                        content=post.content,
                        media_urls=post.media_urls
                    )
                    results[platform.value] = result
                
                except Exception as e:
                    results[platform.value] = PublishResult(
                        platform=platform,
                        success=False,
                        post_id="",
                        post_url="",
                        error_message=str(e),
                        published_at=now
                    )
            
            # Update post with results
            all_success = all(r.success for r in results.values())
            any_success = any(r.success for r in results.values())
            
            if all_success:
                final_status = PostStatus.PUBLISHED
            elif any_success:
                final_status = PostStatus.PUBLISHED  # Partial success
            else:
                final_status = PostStatus.FAILED
            
            update_post_results(post.id, results, final_status)
            
            # Notify user
            await self._notify_user(post, results)
    
    async def _notify_user(self, post: ScheduledPost, results: Dict[str, PublishResult]):
        """Notify user about publish results"""
        
        user = get_user(post.user_id)
        
        success_count = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r.success)
        total_count = len(results)
        
        if success_count == total_count:
            emoji = "✅"
            title = "Post Published Successfully!"
        elif success_count > 0:
            emoji = "⚠️"
            title = "Post Partially Published"
        else:
            emoji = "❌"
            title = "Post Publishing Failed"
        
        message = f"{emoji} *{title}*\n\n"
        message += f"📝 _{post.content[:50]}{'...' if len(post.content) > 50 else ''}_\n\n"
        
        for platform, result in results.items():
            if result.success:
                message += f"✅ *{platform.title()}*: [View Post]({result.post_url})\n"
            else:
                message += f"❌ *{platform.title()}*: {result.error_message}\n"
        
        keyboard = []
        if not all(r.success for r in results.values()):
            keyboard.append([InlineKeyboardButton("🔄 Retry Failed", callback_data=f"retry_{post.id}")])
        
        await bot.send_message(
            user.telegram_id,
            message,
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard) if keyboard else None,
            parse_mode='Markdown',
            disable_web_page_preview=True
        )


class BestTimeAnalyzer:
    """Analyze best posting times based on engagement"""
    
    def __init__(self, user_id: int):
        self.user_id = user_id
    
    def get_best_times(self, platform: Platform, days: int = 30) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get best posting times for a platform"""
        
        # Get historical post performance
        posts = get_user_published_posts(self.user_id, platform, days=days)
        
        if len(posts) < 10:
            # Not enough data, return defaults
            return self._get_default_times(platform)
        
        # Group by hour and calculate average engagement
        hour_performance = {}
        
        for post in posts:
            hour = post.scheduled_at.hour
            engagement = self._calculate_engagement(post)
            
            if hour not in hour_performance:
                hour_performance[hour] = []
            
            hour_performance[hour].append(engagement)
        
        # Calculate averages and sort
        results = []
        for hour, engagements in hour_performance.items():
            avg_engagement = sum(engagements) / len(engagements)
            results.append({
                'hour': hour,
                'avg_engagement': avg_engagement,
                'post_count': len(engagements)
            })
        
        results.sort(key=lambda x: x['avg_engagement'], reverse=True)
        
        return results[:5]  # Top 5 times
    
    def _get_default_times(self, platform: Platform) -> List[Dict]:
        """Default best times based on industry research"""
        
        defaults = {
            Platform.INSTAGRAM: [
                {'hour': 11, 'label': '11:00 AM'},
                {'hour': 13, 'label': '1:00 PM'},
                {'hour': 19, 'label': '7:00 PM'},
            ],
            Platform.TWITTER: [
                {'hour': 9, 'label': '9:00 AM'},
                {'hour': 12, 'label': '12:00 PM'},
                {'hour': 17, 'label': '5:00 PM'},
            ],
            Platform.LINKEDIN: [
                {'hour': 8, 'label': '8:00 AM'},
                {'hour': 10, 'label': '10:00 AM'},
                {'hour': 12, 'label': '12:00 PM'},
            ],
        }
        
        return defaults.get(platform, [{'hour': 12, 'label': '12:00 PM'}])
    
    def _calculate_engagement(self, post: ScheduledPost) -> float:
```

```python
from telegram import Update, InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes, ConversationHandler

# Conversation states
SELECTING_PLATFORMS, ENTERING_CONTENT, ADDING_MEDIA, SCHEDULING = range(4)

async def cmd_new_post(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Start creating a new post"""
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    accounts = get_user_accounts(user_id)
    
    if not accounts:
        await update.message.reply_text(
            "❌ You haven't connected any social accounts yet.\n\n"
            "Use /connect to add your accounts.",
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        return ConversationHandler.END
    
    # Create platform selection keyboard
    keyboard = []
    row = []
    
    for account in accounts:
        emoji = {
            Platform.TWITTER: "🐦",
            Platform.INSTAGRAM: "📷",
            Platform.LINKEDIN: "💼",
            Platform.FACEBOOK: "📘",
            Platform.TELEGRAM_CHANNEL: "📢"
        }.get(account.platform, "📱")
        
        row.append(InlineKeyboardButton(
            f"{emoji} {account.account_username}",
            callback_data=f"platform_{account.id}"
        ))
        
        if len(row) == 2:
            keyboard.append(row)
            row = []
    
    if row:
        keyboard.append(row)
    
    keyboard.append([InlineKeyboardButton("✅ Done Selecting", callback_data="platforms_done")])
    
    context.user_data['selected_platforms'] = []
    
    await update.message.reply_text(
        "📝 *Create New Post*\n\n"
        "Select the platforms where you want to publish:\n"
        "_You can select multiple platforms_",
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )
    
    return SELECTING_PLATFORMS

async def handle_platform_selection(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle platform selection toggle"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    if query.data == "platforms_done":
        selected = context.user_data.get('selected_platforms', [])
        
        if not selected:
            await query.answer("Please select at least one platform!", show_alert=True)
            return SELECTING_PLATFORMS
        
        await query.edit_message_text(
            "✅ *Platforms Selected!*\n\n"
            "Now enter your post content:\n\n"
            "_You can use text, emojis, and hashtags._\n"
            "_For Twitter, content will be truncated to 280 characters._",
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        
        return ENTERING_CONTENT
    
    # Toggle platform selection
    account_id = int(query.data.replace("platform_", ""))
    selected = context.user_data.get('selected_platforms', [])
    
    if account_id in selected:
        selected.remove(account_id)
    else:
        selected.append(account_id)
    
    context.user_data['selected_platforms'] = selected
    
    # Update keyboard to show selection
    await update_platform_keyboard(query, context)
    
    return SELECTING_PLATFORMS

async def handle_content_input(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle post content input"""
    
    content = update.message.text
    context.user_data['post_content'] = content
    
    # Check content length for different platforms
    warnings = []
    
    selected_accounts = [get_account(aid) for aid in context.user_data['selected_platforms']]
    
    for account in selected_accounts:
        if account.platform == Platform.TWITTER and len(content) > 280:
            warnings.append(f"⚠️ Twitter: Content will be truncated to 280 chars (currently {len(content)})")
    
    warning_text = "\n".join(warnings) if warnings else ""
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📷 Add Image", callback_data="add_image")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🎬 Add Video", callback_data="add_video")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("⏭️ Skip Media", callback_data="skip_media")]
    ]
    
    message = f"📝 *Content Preview:*\n\n{content}\n\n"
    if warning_text:
        message += f"{warning_text}\n\n"
    message += "Would you like to add media?"
    
    await update.message.reply_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )
    
    return ADDING_MEDIA

async def handle_media_upload(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle media file upload"""
    
    media_urls = context.user_data.get('media_urls', [])
    
    if update.message.photo:
        # Get highest resolution photo
        photo = update.message.photo[-1]
        file = await context.bot.get_file(photo.file_id)
        
        # Upload to our storage and get URL
        url = await upload_to_storage(file)
        media_urls.append(url)
        context.user_data['media_urls'] = media_urls
        context.user_data['media_type'] = MediaType.IMAGE
        
        await update.message.reply_text(
            f"✅ Image added! ({len(media_urls)} total)\n\n"
            "Send another image or tap Done.",
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup([
                [InlineKeyboardButton("➕ Add More", callback_data="add_more_media")],
                [InlineKeyboardButton("✅ Done", callback_data="media_done")]
            ])
        )
    
    elif update.message.video:
        video = update.message.video
        file = await context.bot.get_file(video.file_id)
        
        url = await upload_to_storage(file)
        media_urls.append(url)
        context.user_data['media_urls'] = media_urls
        context.user_data['media_type'] = MediaType.VIDEO

async def finalize_post(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Create the scheduled post"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    user = get_user(user_id)
    
    # Determine schedule time
    now = datetime.now(pytz.timezone(user.timezone))
    
    if query.data == "schedule_now":
        scheduled_at = now
    elif query.data == "schedule_1h":
        scheduled_at = now + timedelta(hours=1)
    elif query.data == "schedule_3h":
        scheduled_at = now + timedelta(hours=3)
    elif query.data == "schedule_tomorrow_9":
        tomorrow = now + timedelta(days=1)
        scheduled_at = tomorrow.replace(hour=9, minute=0, second=0)
    elif query.data == "schedule_tomorrow_18":
        tomorrow = now + timedelta(days=1)
        scheduled_at = tomorrow.replace(hour=18, minute=0, second=0)
    elif query.data == "schedule_best":
        # Get best time for first platform
        account_id = context.user_data['selected_platforms'][0]
        account = get_account(account_id)
        analyzer = BestTimeAnalyzer(user_id)
        best_times = analyzer.get_best_times(account.platform)
        
        if best_times:
            best_hour = best_times[0]['hour']
            if now.hour < best_hour:
                scheduled_at = now.replace(hour=best_hour, minute=0, second=0)
            else:
                tomorrow = now + timedelta(days=1)
                scheduled_at = tomorrow.replace(hour=best_hour, minute=0, second=0)
        else:
            scheduled_at = now + timedelta(hours=1)
    else:
        scheduled_at = now + timedelta(hours=1)
    
    # Get platforms from account IDs
    platforms = []
    for account_id in context.user_data['selected_platforms']:
        account = get_account(account_id)
        platforms.append(account.platform)
    
    # Create scheduled post
    post = create_scheduled_post(
        user_id=user_id,
        platforms=platforms,
        content=context.user_data['post_content'],
        media_urls=context.user_data.get('media_urls', []),
        media_type=context.user_data.get('media_type', MediaType.IMAGE),
        hashtags=extract_hashtags(context.user_data['post_content']),
        scheduled_at=scheduled_at,
        timezone=user.timezone
    )
    
    # Format confirmation message
    platforms_text = ", ".join([p.value.title() for p in platforms])
    schedule_text = scheduled_at.strftime("%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p")
    
    message = f"""
✅ *Post Scheduled!*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📱 *Platforms:* {platforms_text}
📅 *Scheduled:* {schedule_text}
🌍 *Timezone:* {user.timezone}

📝 *Content:*
_{context.user_data['post_content'][:100]}{'...' if len(context.user_data['post_content']) > 100 else ''}_

{'📷 Media attached' if context.user_data.get('media_urls') else ''}
"""
    
    keyboard = [
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("✏️ Edit", callback_data=f"edit_post_{post.id}"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("❌ Cancel", callback_data=f"cancel_post_{post.id}")
        ],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📋 View Queue", callback_data="view_queue")]
    ]
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )
    
    # Clear user data
    context.user_data.clear()
    
    return ConversationHandler.END
```

# Idea #40: Ad ROI Calculator Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

A bot that connects to advertising platforms (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads) and calculates real ROI, ROAS, and provides optimization recommendations.

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- Manually calculating ROI across platforms is time-consuming
- No unified view of ad performance
- Hard to compare performance across channels
- Missed optimization opportunities
- Expensive analytics tools ($100-500/month)

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass

class AdPlatform(Enum):
    GOOGLE_ADS = "google_ads"
    FACEBOOK_ADS = "facebook_ads"

    TIKTOK_ADS = "tiktok_ads"
    LINKEDIN_ADS = "linkedin_ads"

class CampaignStatus(Enum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    ENDED = "ended"
    DRAFT = "draft"

@dataclass
class AdAccount:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    platform: AdPlatform
    account_id: str
    account_name: str
    currency: str
    access_token: str  # Encrypted
    refresh_token: str  # Encrypted
    token_expires_at: datetime
    is_active: bool
    last_sync: datetime

@dataclass
class Campaign:
    id: int

    external_campaign_id: str

    status: CampaignStatus
    objective: str
    daily_budget: Decimal
    lifetime_budget: Decimal
    start_date: date
    end_date: Optional[date]
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class CampaignMetrics:
    id: int
    campaign_id: int
    date: date
    impressions: int
    clicks: int
    spend: Decimal
    conversions: int
    conversion_value: Decimal
    ctr: float  # Click-through rate
    cpc: Decimal  # Cost per click
    cpm: Decimal  # Cost per 1000 impressions
    cpa: Decimal  # Cost per acquisition
    roas: float  # Return on ad spend
    synced_at: datetime

@dataclass
class DailyAdSummary:
    user_id: int
    date: date
    total_spend: Decimal
    total_impressions: int
    total_clicks: int
    total_conversions: int
    total_revenue: Decimal
    overall_roas: float
    by_platform: Dict[str, Dict]
    top_campaigns: List[Dict]
    alerts: List[str]

@dataclass
class BudgetAlert:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    alert_type: str  # daily_limit, weekly_limit, low_roas, high_cpa
    threshold: Decimal
    current_value: Decimal
    message: str
    is_triggered: bool
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class ROASTarget:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    campaign_id: Optional[int]  # None = account-wide
    target_roas: float
    alert_below: float  # Alert when ROAS falls below this
    created_at: datetime
```

### Platform Connectors

```python
import aiohttp
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Dict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from google.ads.googleads.client import GoogleAdsClient
from facebook_business.api import FacebookAdsApi
from facebook_business.adobjects.adaccount import AdAccount as FBAdAccount

class AdPlatformConnector(ABC):
    """Base class for ad platform connectors"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def test_connection(self) -> bool:
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_campaigns(self) -> List[Campaign]:
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_metrics(self, start_date: date, end_date: date) -> List[CampaignMetrics]:
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_account_info(self) -> Dict:
        pass


class GoogleAdsConnector(AdPlatformConnector):
    """Google Ads API connector"""
    
    def __init__(self, ad_account: AdAccount):
        self.account = ad_account
        self.client = self._initialize_client()
    
    def _initialize_client(self) -> GoogleAdsClient:
        """Initialize Google Ads client"""
        
        credentials = {
            "developer_token": GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN,
            "client_id": GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
            "client_secret": GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
            "refresh_token": self.account.refresh_token,
            "login_customer_id": self.account.account_id
        }
        
        return GoogleAdsClient.load_from_dict(credentials)
    
    async def test_connection(self) -> bool:
        """Test connection to Google Ads"""
        
        try:
            ga_service = self.client.get_service("GoogleAdsService")
            query = "SELECT customer.id FROM customer LIMIT 1"
            
            response = ga_service.search(
                customer_id=self.account.account_id,
                query=query
            )
            
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            log_error(f"Google Ads connection test failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    async def get_campaigns(self) -> List[Campaign]:
        """Get all campaigns from Google Ads"""
        
        ga_service = self.client.get_service("GoogleAdsService")
        
        query = """
            SELECT
                campaign.id,
                campaign.name,
                campaign.status,
                campaign.advertising_channel_type,
                campaign_budget.amount_micros,
                campaign.start_date,
                campaign.end_date
            FROM campaign
            WHERE campaign.status != 'REMOVED'
        """
        
        response = ga_service.search(
            customer_id=self.account.account_id,
            query=query
        )
        
        campaigns = []
        
        for row in response:
            campaign = row.campaign
            budget = row.campaign_budget
            
            status_map = {
                0: CampaignStatus.DRAFT,
                2: CampaignStatus.ACTIVE,
                3: CampaignStatus.PAUSED,
                4: CampaignStatus.ENDED
            }
            
            campaigns.append(Campaign(
                id=0,
                ad_account_id=self.account.id,
                platform=AdPlatform.GOOGLE_ADS,
                external_campaign_id=str(campaign.id),
                name=campaign.name,
                status=status_map.get(campaign.status, CampaignStatus.DRAFT),
                objective=str(campaign.advertising_channel_type),
                daily_budget=Decimal(budget.amount_micros) / 1_000_000,
                lifetime_budget=Decimal(0),
                start_date=datetime.strptime(campaign.start_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date() if campaign.start_date else date.today(),
                end_date=datetime.strptime(campaign.end_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date() if campaign.end_date else None,
                created_at=datetime.now()
            ))
        
        return campaigns
    
    async def get_metrics(self, start_date: date, end_date: date) -> List[CampaignMetrics]:
        """Get campaign metrics from Google Ads"""
        
        ga_service = self.client.get_service("GoogleAdsService")
        
        query = f"""
            SELECT
                campaign.id,
                campaign.name,
                segments.date,
                metrics.impressions,
                metrics.clicks,
                metrics.cost_micros,
                metrics.conversions,
                metrics.conversions_value,
                metrics.ctr,
                metrics.average_cpc,
                metrics.average_cpm
            FROM campaign
            WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}'
        """
        
        response = ga_service.search(
            customer_id=self.account.account_id,
            query=query
        )
        
        metrics_list = []
        
        for row in response:
            campaign = row.campaign
            metrics = row.metrics
            segments = row.segments
            
            spend = Decimal(metrics.cost_micros) / 1_000_000
            conversions = int(metrics.conversions)
            conversion_value = Decimal(str(metrics.conversions_value))
            
            # Calculate derived metrics
            roas = float(conversion_value / spend) if spend > 0 else 0
            cpa = spend / conversions if conversions > 0 else Decimal(0)
            
            metrics_list.append(CampaignMetrics(
                id=0,
                campaign_id=0,  # Will be set when saving
                date=datetime.strptime(segments.date, "%Y-%m-%d").date(),
                impressions=metrics.impressions,
                clicks=metrics.clicks,
                spend=spend,
                conversions=conversions,
                conversion_value=conversion_value,
                ctr=metrics.ctr,
                cpc=Decimal(metrics.average_cpc) / 1_000_000,
                cpm=Decimal(metrics.average_cpm) / 1_000_000,
                cpa=cpa,
                roas=roas,
                synced_at=datetime.now()
            ))
        
        return metrics_list
    
    async def get_account_info(self) -> Dict:
        """Get Google Ads account info"""
        
        ga_service = self.client.get_service("GoogleAdsService")
        
        query = """
            SELECT
                customer.id,
                customer.descriptive_name,
                customer.currency_code,
                customer.time_zone
            FROM customer
        """
        
        response = ga_service.search(
            customer_id=self.account.account_id,
            query=query
        )
        
        for row in response:
            return {
                'id': row.customer.id,
                'name': row.customer.descriptive_name,
                'currency': row.customer.currency_code,
                'timezone': row.customer.time_zone
            }
        
        return {}


class FacebookAdsConnector(AdPlatformConnector):
    """Facebook/Instagram Ads API connector"""
    
    def __init__(self, ad_account: AdAccount):
        self.account = ad_account
        self._initialize_api()
    
    def _initialize_api(self):
        """Initialize Facebook Ads API"""
        
        FacebookAdsApi.init(
            app_id=FACEBOOK_APP_ID,
            app_secret=FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET,
            access_token=self.account.access_token
        )
        
        self.fb_account = FBAdAccount(f'act_{self.account.account_id}')
    
    async def test_connection(self) -> bool:
        """Test connection to Facebook Ads"""
        
        try:
            self.fb_account.api_get(fields=['name', 'account_status'])
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            log_error(f"Facebook Ads connection test failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    async def get_campaigns(self) -> List[Campaign]:
        """Get all campaigns from Facebook Ads"""
        
        campaigns_data = self.fb_account.get_campaigns(
            fields=[
                'id',
                'name',
                'status',
                'objective',
                'daily_budget',
                'lifetime_budget',
                'start_time',
                'stop_time',
                'created_time'
            ]
        )
        
        campaigns = []
        
        for camp in campaigns_data:
            status_map = {
                'ACTIVE': CampaignStatus.ACTIVE,
                'PAUSED': CampaignStatus.PAUSED,
                'DELETED': CampaignStatus.ENDED,
                'ARCHIVED': CampaignStatus.ENDED
            }
            
            campaigns.append(Campaign(
                id=0,
                ad_account_id=self.account.id,
                platform=AdPlatform.FACEBOOK_ADS,
                external_campaign_id=camp['id'],
                name=camp['name'],
                status=status_map.get(camp.get('status', 'ACTIVE'), CampaignStatus.ACTIVE),
                objective=camp.get('objective', ''),
                daily_budget=Decimal(camp.get('daily_budget', 0)) / 100,
                lifetime_budget=Decimal(camp.get('lifetime_budget', 0)) / 100,
                start_date=datetime.fromisoformat(camp['start_time']).date() if camp.get('start_time') else date.today(),
                end_date=datetime.fromisoformat(camp['stop_time']).date() if camp.get('stop_time') else None,
                created_at=datetime.now()
            ))
        
        return campaigns
    
    async def get_metrics(self, start_date: date, end_date: date) -> List[CampaignMetrics]:
        """Get campaign metrics from Facebook Ads"""
        
        insights = self.fb_account.get_insights(
            fields=[
                'campaign_id',
                'campaign_name',
                'impressions',
                'clicks',
                'spend',
                'actions',
                'action_values',
                'ctr',
                'cpc',
                'cpm'
            ],
            params={
                'time_range': {
                    'since': start_date.isoformat(),
                    'until': end_date.isoformat()
                },
                'level': 'campaign',
                'time_increment': 1  # Daily breakdown
            }
        )
        
        metrics_list = []
        
        for insight in insights:
            spend = Decimal(insight.get('spend', 0))
            
            # Extract conversions from actions
            conversions = 0
            conversion_value = Decimal(0)
            
            for action in insight.get('actions', []):
                if action['action_type'] in ['purchase', 'lead', 'complete_registration']:
                    conversions += int(action['value'])
            
            for value in insight.get('action_values', []):
                if value['action_type'] == 'purchase':
                    conversion_value += Decimal(value['value'])
            
            roas = float(conversion_value / spend) if spend > 0 else 0
            cpa = spend / conversions if conversions > 0 else Decimal(0)
            
            metrics_list.append(CampaignMetrics(
                id=0,
                campaign_id=0,
                date=datetime.strptime(insight['date_start'], "%Y-%m-%d").date(),
                impressions=int(insight.get('impressions', 0)),
                clicks=int(insight.get('clicks', 0)),
                spend=spend,
                conversions=conversions,
                conversion_value=conversion_value,
                ctr=float(insight.get('ctr', 0)),
                cpc=Decimal(insight.get('cpc', 0)),
                cpm=Decimal(insight.get('cpm', 0)),
                cpa=cpa,
                roas=roas,
                synced_at=datetime.now()
            ))
        
        return metrics_list
    
    async def get_account_info(self) -> Dict:
        """Get Facebook Ads account info"""
        
        data = self.fb_account.api_get(
            fields=['name', 'currency', 'timezone_name', 'amount_spent']
        )
        
        return {
            'id': self.account.account_id,
            'name': data.get('name', ''),
            'currency': data.get('currency', 'USD'),
            'timezone': data.get('timezone_name', 'UTC'),
            'total_spent': Decimal(data.get('amount_spent', 0)) / 100
        }
```

### ROI Analytics Engine

```python
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from typing import List, Dict, Optional
import statistics

class ROIAnalytics:
    """ROI and ROAS analytics engine"""
    
    def __init__(self, user_id: int):
        self.user_id = user_id
    
    def calculate_daily_summary(self, target_date: date) -> DailyAdSummary:
        """Calculate daily ad performance summary"""
        
        # Get all metrics for the day
        accounts = get_user_ad_accounts(self.user_id)
        
        total_spend = Decimal(0)
        total_impressions = 0
        total_clicks = 0
        total_conversions = 0
        total_revenue = Decimal(0)
        
        by_platform = {}
        all_campaigns = []
        alerts = []
        
        for account in accounts:
            metrics = get_account_metrics_for_date(account.id, target_date)
            
            platform_spend = sum(m.spend for m in metrics)
            platform_impressions = sum(m.impressions for m in metrics)
            platform_clicks = sum(m.clicks for m in metrics)
            platform_conversions = sum(m.conversions for m in metrics)
            platform_revenue = sum(m.conversion_value for m in metrics)
            
            platform_roas = float(platform_revenue / platform_spend) if platform_spend > 0 else 0
            
            by_platform[account.platform.value] = {
                'spend': float(platform_spend),
                'impressions': platform_impressions,
                'clicks': platform_clicks,
                'conversions': platform_conversions,
                'revenue': float(platform_revenue),
                'roas': platform_roas,
                'ctr': (platform_clicks / platform_impressions * 100) if platform_impressions > 0 else 0
            }
            
            total_spend += platform_spend
            total_impressions += platform_impressions
            total_clicks += platform_clicks
            total_conversions += platform_conversions
            total_revenue += platform_revenue
            
            # Add campaign details
            for m in metrics:
                campaign = get_campaign_by_metrics(m.campaign_id)
                all_campaigns.append({
                    'name': campaign.name,
                    'platform': account.platform.value,
                    'spend': float(m.spend),
                    'conversions': m.conversions,
                    'roas': m.roas
                })
        
        # Sort campaigns by ROAS
        top_campaigns = sorted(all_campaigns, key=lambda x: x['roas'], reverse=True)[:5]
        
        # Check for alerts
        alerts = self._check_alerts(by_platform, total_spend, total_revenue)
        
        overall_roas = float(total_revenue / total_spend) if total_spend > 0 else 0
        
        return DailyAdSummary(
            user_id=self.user_id,
            date=target_date,
            total_spend=total_spend,
            total_impressions=total_impressions,
            total_clicks=total_clicks,
            total_conversions=total_conversions,
            total_revenue=total_revenue,
            overall_roas=overall_roas,
            by_platform=by_platform,
            top_campaigns=top_campaigns,
            alerts=alerts
        )
    
    def _check_alerts(
        self, 
        by_platform: Dict, 
        total_spend: Decimal, 
        total_revenue: Decimal
    ) -> List[str]:
        """Check for performance alerts"""
        
        alerts = []
        targets = get_user_roas_targets(self.user_id)
        
        for target in targets:
            if target.campaign_id:
                # Campaign-specific target
                campaign = get_campaign(target.campaign_id)
                metrics = get_latest_campaign_metrics(target.campaign_id)
                
                if metrics and metrics.roas < target.alert_below:
                    alerts.append(
                        f"⚠️ {campaign.name}: ROAS ({metrics.roas:.2f}x) below target ({target.alert_below}x)"
                    )
            else:
                # Account-wide target
                overall_roas = float(total_revenue / total_spend) if total_spend > 0 else 0
                
                if overall_roas < target.alert_below:
                    alerts.append(
                        f"⚠️ Overall ROAS ({overall_roas:.2f}x) below target ({target.alert_below}x)"
                    )
        
        # Check for budget alerts
        budget_alerts = get_user_budget_alerts(self.user_id)
        
        for alert in budget_alerts:
            if alert.alert_type == 'daily_limit' and total_spend >= alert.threshold:
                alerts.append(f"💰 Daily spend (${total_spend:.2f}) reached limit (${alert.threshold:.2f})")
        
        return alerts
    
    def get_trend_analysis(self, days: int = 30) -> Dict:
        """Analyze performance trends over time"""
        
        end_date = date.today()
        start_date = end_date - timedelta(days=days)
        
        daily_data = []
        
        for i in range(days):
            current_date = start_date + timedelta(days=i)
            summary = self.calculate_daily_summary(current_date)
            
            daily_data.append({
                'date': current_date.isoformat(),
                'spend': float(summary.total_spend),
                'revenue': float(summary.total_revenue),
                'roas': summary.overall_roas,
                'conversions': summary.total_conversions
            })
        
        # Calculate trends
        spends = [d['spend'] for d in daily_data]
        revenues = [d['revenue'] for d in daily_data]
        roas_values = [d['roas'] for d in daily_data if d['roas'] > 0]
        
        # Week over week comparison
        this_week_spend = sum(d['spend'] for d in daily_data[-7:])
        last_week_spend = sum(d['spend'] for d in daily_data[-14:-7])
        
        this_week_revenue = sum(d['revenue'] for d in daily_data[-7:])
        last_week_revenue = sum(d['revenue'] for d in daily_data[-14:-7])
        
        spend_change = ((this_week_spend - last_week_spend) / last_week_spend * 100) if last_week_spend > 0 else 0
        revenue_change = ((this_week_revenue - last_week_revenue) / last_week_revenue * 100) if last_week_revenue > 0 else 0
        
        return {
            'period_days': days,
            'total_spend': sum(spends),
            'total_revenue': sum(revenues),
            'avg_daily_spend': statistics.mean(spends) if spends else 0,
            'avg_daily_revenue': statistics.mean(revenues) if revenues else 0,
            'avg_roas': statistics.mean(roas_values) if roas_values else 0,
            'best_roas_day': max(daily_data, key=lambda x: x['roas']),
            'worst_roas_day': min(daily_data, key=lambda x: x['roas']) if daily_data else None,
            'week_over_week': {
                'spend_change_pct': spend_change,
                'revenue_change_pct': revenue_change
            },
            'daily_data': daily_data
        }
    
    def get_recommendations(self) -> List[Dict]:
        """Generate optimization recommendations"""
        
        recommendations = []
        
        # Get last 7 days data
        accounts = get_user_ad_accounts(self.user_id)
        
        for account in accounts:
            campaigns = get_account_campaigns(account.id)
            
            for campaign in campaigns:
                if campaign.status != CampaignStatus.ACTIVE:
                    continue
                
                metrics = get_campaign_metrics_range(
                    campaign.id,
                    date.today() - timedelta(days=7),
                    date.today()
                )
                
                if not metrics:
                    continue
                
                avg_roas = statistics.mean([m.roas for m in metrics])
                avg_cpa = statistics.mean([float(m.cpa) for m in metrics])
                avg_ctr = statistics.mean([m.ctr for m in metrics])
                total_spend = sum(m.spend for m in metrics)
                
                # Low ROAS recommendation
                if avg_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 50:
                    recommendations.append({
                        'type': 'low_roas',
                        'priority': 'high',
                        'campaign': campaign.name,
                        'platform': account.platform.value,
                        'message': f"ROAS is {avg_roas:.2f}x (below break-even). Consider pausing or optimizing.",
                        'action': 'pause_or_optimize'
                    })
                
                # High CPA recommendation
                target_cpa = get_target_cpa(campaign.id)
                if target_cpa and avg_cpa > float(target_cpa) * 1.5:
                    recommendations.append({
                        'type': 'high_cpa',
                        'priority': 'medium',
                        'campaign': campaign.name,
                        'platform': account.platform.value,
                        'message': f"CPA (${avg_cpa:.2f}) is 50% above target (${target_cpa:.2f}). Review targeting.",
                        'action': 'review_targeting'
                    })
                
                # Low CTR recommendation
                if avg_ctr < 0.5:
                    recommendations.append({
                        'type': 'low_ctr',
                        'priority': 'medium',
                        'campaign': campaign.name,
                        'platform': account.platform.value,
                        'message': f"CTR is {avg_ctr:.2f}% (below average). Consider updating ad creatives.",
                        'action': 'update_creatives'
                    })
                
                # High performing - scale up
                if avg_roas > 3.0 and total_spend < float(campaign.daily_budget) * 7 * 0.8:
                    recommendations.append({
                        'type': 'scale_opportunity',
                        'priority': 'high',
                        'campaign': campaign.name,
                        'platform': account.platform.value,
                        'message': f"Strong ROAS ({avg_roas:.2f}x) with room in budget. Consider scaling up.",
                        'action': 'increase_budget'
                    })
        
        # Sort by priority
        priority_order = {'high': 0, 'medium': 1, 'low': 2}
        recommendations.sort(key=lambda x: priority_order.get(x['priority'], 99))
        
        return recommendations
```

### Telegram Handlers

```python
from telegram import Update, InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes

async def cmd_roi(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show ROI dashboard"""
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    accounts = get_user_ad_accounts(user_id)
    
    if not accounts:
        await update.message.reply_text(
            "❌ No ad accounts connected.\n\n"
            "Use /connect_ads to link your advertising accounts.",
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        return
    
    loading = await update.message.reply_text("📊 Calculating your ROI...")
    
    analytics = ROIAnalytics(user_id)
    
    # Get today's summary
    today_summary = analytics.calculate_daily_summary(date.today())
    
    # Get yesterday for comparison
    yesterday_summary = analytics.calculate_daily_summary(date.today() - timedelta(days=1))
    
    # Calculate changes
    spend_change = 0
    roas_change = 0
    
    if yesterday_summary.total_spend > 0:
        spend_change = float((today_summary.total_spend - yesterday_summary.total_spend) / yesterday_summary.total_spend * 100)
    
    if yesterday_summary.overall_roas > 0:
        roas_change = ((today_summary.overall_roas - yesterday_summary.overall_roas) / yesterday_summary.overall_roas * 100)
    
    spend_emoji = "📈" if spend_change > 0 else "📉" if spend_change < 0 else "➡️"
    roas_emoji = "📈" if roas_change > 0 else "📉" if roas_change < 0 else "➡️"
    
    message = f"""
📊 *Ad Performance Dashboard*
📅 {date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y')}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💰 *Total Spend:* ${today_summary.total_spend:,.2f}
{spend_emoji} vs Yesterday: {spend_change:+.1f}%

💵 *Total Revenue:* ${today_summary.total_revenue:,.2f}
📈 *ROAS:* {today_summary.overall_roas:.2f}x
{roas_emoji} vs Yesterday: {roas_change:+.1f}%

👆 *Clicks:* {today_summary.total_clicks:,}
🎯 *Conversions:* {today_summary.total_conversions}

📱 *By Platform:*
"""
    
    platform_emojis = {
        'google_ads': '🔍',
        'facebook_ads': '📘',
        'instagram_ads': '📷',
        'tiktok_ads': '🎵'
    }
    
    for platform, data in today_summary.by_platform.items():
        emoji = platform_emojis.get(platform, '📱')
        roas_indicator = "🟢" if data['roas'] >= 2 else "🟡" if data['roas'] >= 1 else "🔴"
        
        message += f"\n{emoji} *{platform.replace('_', ' ').title()}*\n"
        message += f"   💰 ${data['spend']:,.2f} | {roas_indicator} {data['roas']:.2f}x ROAS\n"
    
    # Add alerts
    if today_summary.alerts:
        message += "\n⚠️ *Alerts:*\n"
        for alert in today_summary.alerts[:3]:
            message += f"• {alert}\n"
    
    keyboard = [
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("📈 Trends", callback_data="roi_trends"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("💡 Tips", callback_data="roi_recommendations")
        ],
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("📋 Campaigns", callback_data="roi_campaigns"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("🎯 Set Goals", callback_data="roi_goals")
        ],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📥 Export Report", callback_data="roi_export")]
    ]
    
    await loading.edit_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def show_recommendations(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show optimization recommendations"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()

        'high': '🔴',
        'medium': '🟡',
        'low': '🟢'
    }
    
    for i, rec in enumerate(recommendations[:5], 1):
        emoji = priority_emoji.get(rec['priority'], '⚪')
        
        message += f"{emoji} *{rec['campaign']}*\n"
        message += f"   📱 {rec['platform'].replace('_', ' ').title()}\n"

    await query.edit_message_text(

    """Scheduled daily ROI report"""
    
    users = get_users_with_ad_accounts()
    
    for user in users:
        try:
            analytics = ROIAnalytics(user.id)
            yesterday = date.today() - timedelta(days=1)
            summary = analytics.calculate_daily_summary(yesterday)
            
            # Skip if no spend
            if summary.total_spend == 0:
                continue
            
            roas_emoji = "🟢" if summary.overall_roas >= 2 else "🟡" if summary.overall_roas >= 1 else "🔴"
            
            message = f"""
📊 *Daily Ad Report*

💵 Revenue: ${summary.total_revenue:,.2f}
{roas_emoji} ROAS: {summary.overall_roas:.2f}x
🎯 Conversions: {summary.total_conversions}
"""
            
            # Add top campaigns
            if summary.top_campaigns:
                message += "\n🏆 *Top Performers:*\n"
                for camp in summary.top_campaigns[:3]:
                    message += f"• {camp['name']}: {camp['roas']:.2f}x\n"
            
            # Add alerts
            if summary.alerts:
                message += "\n⚠️ *Alerts:*\n"
                for alert in summary.alerts:
                    message += f"• {alert}\n"
            
            keyboard = [[InlineKeyboardButton("📊 Full Dashboard", callback_data="roi_dashboard")]]
            
            await context.bot.send_message(
                user.telegram_id,
                message,
                reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
                parse_mode='Markdown'
            )
        
        except Exception as e:
            log_error(f"Failed to send ROI report to user {user.id}: {e}")
```

```python
"""
Stock News Bot - Telegram Handlers (Continued)
"""

async def _send_user_digest(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE, user):
    """Send digest to a single user (continued)"""
    
    watchlist = get_user_watchlist(user.id)
    
    if not watchlist:
        return
    
    symbols = [item.symbol for item in watchlist]
    
    # Fetch news from last 24 hours
    aggregator = NewsAggregator()
    articles = await aggregator.fetch_news_for_symbols(symbols, hours=24)
    
    if not articles:
        return
    
    # Analyze and score
    analyzer = SentimentAnalyzer()
    preferences = get_user_preferences(user.id)
    scorer = RelevanceScorer()
    
    for article in articles:
        sentiment, score = await analyzer.analyze(article.title, article.summary)
        article.sentiment = sentiment
        article.sentiment_score = score
        article.relevance_score = scorer.score(article, symbols, preferences)
    
    # Filter by minimum relevance
    min_relevance = preferences.min_relevance if preferences else 0.3
    articles = [a for a in articles if a.relevance_score >= min_relevance]
    
    if not articles:
        return
    
    # Sort and take top 10
    articles.sort(key=lambda x: x.relevance_score, reverse=True)
    articles = articles[:10]
    
    # Group by sentiment
    bullish = [a for a in articles if a.sentiment in [Sentiment.BULLISH, Sentiment.VERY_BULLISH]]
    bearish = [a for a in articles if a.sentiment in [Sentiment.BEARISH, Sentiment.VERY_BEARISH]]
    neutral = [a for a in articles if a.sentiment == Sentiment.NEUTRAL]
    
    message = f"""
📰 *Daily News Digest*
📅 {datetime.now().strftime('%B %d, %Y')}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📊 *Summary:*
🟢 Bullish: {len(bullish)} articles
🔴 Bearish: {len(bearish)} articles
⚪ Neutral: {len(neutral)} articles

"""
    
    # Add top stories
    message += "*📌 Top Stories:*\n\n"
    
    for article in articles[:5]:
        sentiment_emoji = {
            Sentiment.VERY_BULLISH: "🚀",
            Sentiment.BULLISH: "📈",
            Sentiment.NEUTRAL: "➡️",
            Sentiment.BEARISH: "📉",
            Sentiment.VERY_BEARISH: "💥"
        }.get(article.sentiment, "➡️")
        
        message += (
            f"{sentiment_emoji} *{article.title[:50]}{'...' if len(article.title) > 50 else ''}*\n"
            f"   {' '.join(['$' + s for s in article.symbols[:2]])} | "
            f"[Read]({article.url})\n\n"
        )
    
    # Add earnings reminders if any
    upcoming_earnings = get_upcoming_earnings(symbols, days=7)
    
    if upcoming_earnings:
        message += "\n📅 *Upcoming Earnings:*\n"
        for event in upcoming_earnings[:3]:
            message += f"• *{event.symbol}* - {event.report_date.strftime('%b %d')} ({event.call_time})\n"
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📰 More News", callback_data="more_news")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📋 My Watchlist", callback_data="show_watchlist")]
    ]
    
    try:
        await context.bot.send_message(
            user.telegram_id,
            message,
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown',
            disable_web_page_preview=True
        )
        
        logger.info(f"Sent daily digest to user {user.id}")
    
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to send digest to user {user.id}: {e}")


async def check_breaking_news(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Check for breaking news and send alerts (runs every 15 minutes)"""
    
    logger.info("Checking for breaking news...")
    
    # Get all unique symbols from all users' watchlists
    all_symbols = get_all_watched_symbols()
    
    if not all_symbols:
        return
    
    # Fetch recent news (last 30 minutes)
    aggregator = NewsAggregator()
    articles = await aggregator.fetch_news_for_symbols(all_symbols, hours=0.5)
    
    if not articles:
        return
    
    # Analyze sentiment
    analyzer = SentimentAnalyzer()
    
    for article in articles:
        # Skip if already processed
        if is_article_processed(article.url):
            continue
        
        sentiment, score = await analyzer.analyze(article.title, article.summary)
        article.sentiment = sentiment
        article.sentiment_score = score
        
        # Mark as processed
        mark_article_processed(article.url)
        
        # Only alert for high-impact news
        if abs(score) < 0.4:
            continue
        
        # Find users watching these symbols
        users = get_users_watching_symbols(article.symbols)
        
        for user in users:
            if not user.breaking_news_enabled:
                continue
            
            await send_breaking_alert(context, user, article)


async def send_breaking_alert(context, user, article: NewsArticle):
    """Send breaking news alert to user"""
    
    sentiment_emoji = {
        Sentiment.VERY_BULLISH: "🚀",
        Sentiment.BULLISH: "📈",
        Sentiment.NEUTRAL: "➡️",
        Sentiment.BEARISH: "📉",
        Sentiment.VERY_BEARISH: "💥"
    }.get(article.sentiment, "➡️")
    
    urgency_emoji = "🚨" if abs(article.sentiment_score) > 0.6 else "📢"
    
    symbols_text = " ".join([f"${s}" for s in article.symbols[:3]])
    
    message = f"""
{urgency_emoji} *Breaking News Alert*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

{sentiment_emoji} *{article.title}*

{symbols_text}

📰 {article.summary[:200]}{'...' if len(article.summary) > 200 else ''}

🔗 [Read Full Article]({article.url})

⏰ {article.published_at.strftime('%I:%M %p')}
"""
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📊 Get Quote", callback_data=f"quote_{article.symbols[0]}")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔕 Mute 1 hour", callback_data="mute_1h")]
    ]
    
    try:
        await context.bot.send_message(
            user.telegram_id,
            message,
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown',
            disable_web_page_preview=True
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to send breaking alert to user {user.id}: {e}")


async def check_earnings_reminders(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Check and send earnings reminders (runs daily)"""
    
    # Get all users with watchlists
    users = get_all_users_with_watchlists()
    
    for user in users:
        try:
            watchlist = get_user_watchlist(user.id)
            symbols = [item.symbol for item in watchlist]
            
            # Check for earnings tomorrow
            tomorrow = datetime.now().date() + timedelta(days=1)
            earnings = get_earnings_for_date(symbols, tomorrow)
            
            if not earnings:
                continue
            
            message = "📅 *Earnings Reminder*\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
            message += f"*Tomorrow ({tomorrow.strftime('%B %d')})*\n\n"
            
            for event in earnings:
                time_text = "Before Market" if event.call_time == "BMO" else "After Close"
                
                est_text = ""
                if event.eps_estimate:
                    est_text = f" | Est. EPS: ${event.eps_estimate:.2f}"
                
                message += f"• *{event.symbol}* - {event.company_name[:30]}\n"
                message += f"   ⏰ {time_text}{est_text}\n\n"
            
            keyboard = [[InlineKeyboardButton("📊 View Details", callback_data="earnings_details")]]
            
            await context.bot.send_message(
                user.telegram_id,
                message,
                reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
                parse_mode='Markdown'
            )
        
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error sending earnings reminder to user {user.id}: {e}")

async def handle_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle callback queries"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    data = query.data
    
    if data == "watchlist_add":
        await handle_add_stock(update, context)
    
    elif data == "watchlist_remove":
        await handle_remove_stock(update, context)
    
    elif data == "show_watchlist":
        await show_watchlist(update, context)
    
    elif data == "get_watchlist_news":
        await get_watchlist_news(update, context)
    
    elif data == "refresh_news":
        await refresh_news(update, context)
    
    elif data == "toggle_digest":
        await toggle_digest(update, context)
    
    elif data == "toggle_breaking":
        await toggle_breaking_news(update, context)
    
    elif data.startswith("quote_"):
        symbol = data.replace("quote_", "")
        await show_stock_quote(update, context, symbol)
    
    elif data == "mute_1h":
        await mute_alerts(update, context, hours=1)
    
    elif data == "main_menu":
        await show_main_menu(update, context)

def setup_handlers(application):
    """Setup all bot handlers"""
    
    # Command handlers
    application.add_handler(CommandHandler("start", cmd_start))
    application.add_handler(CommandHandler("watchlist", cmd_watchlist))
    application.add_handler(CommandHandler("news", cmd_news))
    application.add_handler(CommandHandler("settings", cmd_settings))
    
    # Conversation handler for adding stocks
    add_stock_conv = ConversationHandler(
        entry_points=[CallbackQueryHandler(handle_add_stock, pattern="^watchlist_add$")],
        states={
            ADDING_SYMBOL: [MessageHandler(filters.TEXT & ~filters.COMMAND, receive_symbol)]
        },
        fallbacks=[CommandHandler("cancel", lambda u, c: ConversationHandler.END)]
    )
    application.add_handler(add_stock_conv)
    
    # Callback query handler
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(handle_callback))
    
    # Scheduled jobs
    job_queue = application.job_queue
    
    # Daily digest - check every hour
    job_queue.run_repeating(
        send_daily_digest,
        interval=3600,  # Every hour
        first=60
    )
    
    # Breaking news - check every 15 minutes
    job_queue.run_repeating(
        check_breaking_news,
        interval=900,  # Every 15 minutes
        first=30
    )
    
    # Earnings reminders - check daily at 6 PM
    job_queue.run_daily(
        check_earnings_reminders,
        time=datetime.strptime("18:00", "%H:%M").time()
    )
```

# Idea #44: Gold/Dollar Price Alert Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

A simple but powerful bot for tracking gold, silver, and currency prices with customizable alerts. Particularly valuable in markets with currency volatility (Iran, Turkey, emerging markets).

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- Constantly checking exchange rate websites
- Missing important price movements
- No consolidated view of multiple assets
- Currency hedging timing
- Gold price tracking for investment

## ⭐ Key Features

```
Phase 1 (Week 1-2):
├── Real-time gold price (international + local)
├── Major currency pairs (USD, EUR, GBP, etc.)
├── Customizable price alerts
├── Daily price summary
├── Price change notifications
└── Historical charts

Phase 2 (Week 2-3):
├── Multiple local currencies (IRR, TRY, etc.)
├── Crypto prices (BTC, ETH)
├── Spread tracking
├── Calculator tools
├── Multiple data sources comparison
└── Trend analysis
```

## 👨‍💻 Complete Implementation

### Data Models

```python
"""
Gold/Dollar Price Alert Bot - Data Models
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum

class AssetType(Enum):
    GOLD = "gold"
    SILVER = "silver"
    CURRENCY = "currency"
    CRYPTO = "crypto"

class AlertType(Enum):
    ABOVE = "above"
    BELOW = "below"
    CHANGE_PERCENT = "change_percent"

class AlertStatus(Enum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    TRIGGERED = "triggered"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"

@dataclass
class Asset:
    symbol: str
    name: str
    asset_type: AssetType
    base_currency: str
    current_price: Decimal
    change_24h: Decimal
    change_percent_24h: float
    high_24h: Decimal
```

### Price Data Service

```python
"""
Gold/Dollar Price Alert Bot - Price Data Service
"""

import aiohttp
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
from decimal import Decimal
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class PriceDataService:
    """Fetches price data from multiple sources"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.cache = {}
        self.cache_ttl = 60  # seconds
        self.sources = {
            'metals': MetalsDataSource(),
            'forex': ForexDataSource(),
            'crypto': CryptoDataSource(),
            'local': LocalCurrencySource(),
        }
    
    async def get_price(self, symbol: str) -> Optional[Asset]:
        """Get current price for an asset"""
        
        # Check cache
        cached = self._get_from_cache(symbol)
        if cached:
            return cached
        
        # Determine source based on symbol
        source = self._get_source_for_symbol(symbol)
        
        if not source:
            logger.warning(f"No source found for symbol: {symbol}")
            return None
        
        try:
            asset = await source.get_price(symbol)
            
            if asset:
                self._set_cache(symbol, asset)
            
            return asset
        
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error fetching price for {symbol}: {e}")
            return None
    
    async def get_prices(self, symbols: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Asset]:
        """Get prices for multiple assets"""
        
        tasks = [self.get_price(symbol) for symbol in symbols]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        prices = {}
        for symbol, result in zip(symbols, results):
            if isinstance(result, Asset):
                prices[symbol] = result
        
        return prices
    
    def _get_source_for_symbol(self, symbol: str):
        """Determine which data source to use for a symbol"""
        
        symbol_upper = symbol.upper()
        
        if symbol_upper in ['XAU', 'GOLD', 'XAG', 'SILVER']:
            return self.sources['metals']
        
        if symbol_upper in ['BTC', 'ETH', 'USDT', 'BNB']:
            return self.sources['crypto']
        
        if symbol_upper.startswith('USD') or symbol_upper.endswith('USD'):
            return self.sources['forex']
        
        if symbol_upper in ['IRR', 'TRY', 'AED']:
            return self.sources['local']
        
        return self.sources['forex']
    
    def _get_from_cache(self, symbol: str) -> Optional[Asset]:
        """Get price from cache if not expired"""
        
        if symbol not in self.cache:
            return None
        
        cached_data, cached_time = self.cache[symbol]
        
        if datetime.now() - cached_time > timedelta(seconds=self.cache_ttl):
            del self.cache[symbol]
            return None
        
        return cached_data
    
    def _set_cache(self, symbol: str, asset: Asset):
        """Set price in cache"""
        self.cache[symbol] = (asset, datetime.now())


class MetalsDataSource:
    """Gold and silver price data source"""
    
    # Using free API - in production, use premium API for reliability
    API_URL = "https://api.metalpriceapi.com/v1/latest"
    API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY"  # Get free key from metalpriceapi.com
    
    async def get_price(self, symbol: str) -> Optional[Asset]:
        """Get gold or silver price"""
        
        # Map common names to API symbols
        symbol_map = {
            'XAU': 'XAU',
            'GOLD': 'XAU',
            'XAG': 'XAG',
            'SILVER': 'XAG',
        }
        
        api_symbol = symbol_map.get(symbol.upper())
        
        if not api_symbol:
            return None
        
        try:
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
                params = {
                    'api_key': self.API_KEY,
                    'base': 'USD',
                    'currencies': api_symbol
                }
                
                async with session.get(self.API_URL, params=params) as response:
                    if response.status != 200:
                        return None
                    
                    data = await response.json()
                    
                    if not data.get('success'):
                        return None
                    
                    rate = data['rates'].get(api_symbol)
                    
                    if not rate:
                        return None
                    
                    # API returns 1/price (how much gold per 1 USD)
                    price = Decimal(str(1 / rate))
                    
                    return Asset(
                        symbol=symbol.upper(),
                        name="Gold (oz)" if api_symbol == 'XAU' else "Silver (oz)",
                        asset_type=AssetType.GOLD if api_symbol == 'XAU' else AssetType.SILVER,
                        base_currency='USD',
                        current_price=price.quantize(Decimal('0.01')),
                        change_24h=Decimal('0'),  # Would need historical data
                        change_percent_24h=0.0,
                        high_24h=price,
                        low_24h=price,
                        last_updated=datetime.now()
                    )
        
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error fetching metal price: {e}")
            return None


class ForexDataSource:
    """Currency exchange rate data source"""
    
    # Using free API - exchangerate-api.com
    API_URL = "https://v6.exchangerate-api.com/v6/{api_key}/latest/{base}"
    API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY"  # Get free key
    
    async def get_price(self, symbol: str) -> Optional[Asset]:
        """Get currency exchange rate"""
        
        # Parse symbol (e.g., "USDEUR" -> USD to EUR)
        symbol_upper = symbol.upper()
        
        if len(symbol_upper) == 6:
            base = symbol_upper[:3]
            quote = symbol_upper[3:]
        elif symbol_upper.startswith('USD'):
            base = 'USD'
            quote = symbol_upper[3:]
        else:
            base = 'USD'
            quote = symbol_upper
        
        try:
            url = self.API_URL.format(api_key=self.API_KEY, base=base)
            
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
                async with session.get(url) as response:
                    if response.status != 200:
                        return None
                    
                    data = await response.json()
                    
                    if data.get('result') != 'success':
                        return None
                    
                    rate = data['conversion_rates'].get(quote)
                    
                    if not rate:
                        return None
                    
                    return Asset(
                        symbol=f"{base}{quote}",
                        name=f"{base}/{quote}",
                        asset_type=AssetType.CURRENCY,
                        base_currency=base,
                        current_price=Decimal(str(rate)).quantize(Decimal('0.0001')),
                        change_24h=Decimal('0'),
                        change_percent_24h=0.0,
                        high_24h=Decimal(str(rate)),
                        low_24h=Decimal(str(rate)),
                        last_updated=datetime.now()
                    )
        
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error fetching forex rate: {e}")
            return None
```

### Alert Manager

```python
"""
Gold/Dollar Price Alert Bot - Alert Manager
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import List, Optional
from decimal import Decimal
import asyncio
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class AlertManager:
    """Manages price alerts"""
    
    def __init__(self, price_service: PriceDataService):
        self.price_service = price_service
        self.running = False
        self.check_interval = 30  # seconds
    
    async def start(self):
        """Start alert monitoring"""
        
        logger.info("Starting alert manager...")
        self.running = True
        
        while self.running:
            try:
                await self._check_alerts()
                await asyncio.sleep(self.check_interval)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                break
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Alert check error: {e}")
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
    
    async def stop(self):
        """Stop alert monitoring"""
        self.running = False
    
    async def _check_alerts(self):
        """Check all active alerts"""
        
        active_alerts = get_active_alerts()
        
        if not active_alerts:
            return
        
        # Get unique symbols
        symbols = list(set(a.asset_symbol for a in active_alerts))
        
        # Fetch current prices
        prices = await self.price_service.get_prices(symbols)
        
        for alert in active_alerts:
            if alert.asset_symbol not in prices:
                continue
            
            current_price = prices[alert.asset_symbol].current_price
            
            # Check if alert should trigger
            triggered = self._check_trigger(alert, current_price)
            
            if triggered:
                await self._trigger_alert(alert, current_price)
    
    def _check_trigger(self, alert: PriceAlert, current_price: Decimal) -> bool:
        """Check if alert condition is met"""
        
        if alert.alert_type == AlertType.ABOVE:
            return current_price >= alert.target_value
        
        elif alert.alert_type == AlertType.BELOW:
            return current_price <= alert.target_value
        
        elif alert.alert_type == AlertType.CHANGE_PERCENT:
            if alert.current_value == 0:
                return False
            
            change_pct = abs((current_price - alert.current_value) / alert.current_value * 100)
            return change_pct >= float(alert.target_value)
        
        return False
    
    async def _trigger_alert(self, alert: PriceAlert, current_price: Decimal):
        """Trigger an alert and notify user"""
        
        logger.info(f"Triggering alert {alert.id} for user {alert.user_id}")
        
        # Update alert status
        update_alert_status(alert.id, AlertStatus.TRIGGERED, current_price)
        
        # Get user
        user = get_user(alert.user_id)
        
        if not user:
            return
        
        # Send notification
        await send_alert_notification(user, alert, current_price)
    
    async def create_alert(
        self,
        user_id: int,
        asset_symbol: str,
        alert_type: AlertType,
        target_value: Decimal,
        note: str = "",
        expires_in_days: int = 30
    ) -> PriceAlert:
        """Create a new price alert"""
        
        # Get current price
        asset = await self.price_service.get_price(asset_symbol)
        
        if not asset:
            raise ValueError(f"Could not fetch price for {asset_symbol}")
        
        expires_at = datetime.now() + timedelta(days=expires_in_days) if expires_in_days > 0 else None
        
        alert = create_price_alert(
            user_id=user_id,
            asset_symbol=asset_symbol,
            alert_type=alert_type,
            target_value=target_value,
            current_value=asset.current_price,
            note=note,
            expires_at=expires_at
        )
        
        logger.info(f"Created alert {alert.id} for {asset_symbol} at {target_value}")
        
        return alert


async def send_alert_notification(user, alert: PriceAlert, current_price: Decimal):
    """Send alert notification to user"""
    
    alert_type_text = {
        AlertType.ABOVE: "🔺 Price Above Target",
        AlertType.BELOW: "🔻 Price Below Target",
        AlertType.CHANGE_PERCENT: "📊 Price Changed Significantly",
    }.get(alert.alert_type, "🔔 Price Alert")
    
    # Determine direction
    if current_price > alert.current_value:
        direction = "📈"
        change = current_price - alert.current_value
    else:
        direction = "📉"
        change = alert.current_value - current_price
    
    change_pct = (change / alert.current_value * 100) if alert.current_value > 0 else 0
    
    message = f"""
🔔 *{alert_type_text}*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📊 *{alert.asset_symbol}*

💲 *Current Price:* {current_price:,.2f}
🎯 *Target:* {alert.target_value:,.2f}
{direction} *Change:* {change:,.2f} ({change_pct:+.2f}%)

📝 {alert.note if alert.note else ''}

⏰ {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}
"""
    
    keyboard = [
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("📊 Current Prices", callback_data="prices"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("🔔 New Alert", callback_data=f"new_alert_{alert.asset_symbol}")
        ]
    ]
    
    try:
        await bot.send_message(
            user.telegram_id,
            message,
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to send alert to user {user.id}: {e}")
```

```python
"""
Gold/Dollar Price Alert Bot - Telegram Handlers
"""

from telegram import Update, InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup

from decimal import Decimal

]

    type_text = {
        AlertType.ABOVE: f"when price goes above {target:,.2f}",
        AlertType.BELOW: f"when price goes below {target:,.2f}",
        AlertType.CHANGE_PERCENT: f"when price changes by {target}%",
    }.get(alert_type, "")
    
    await update.message.reply_text(
        f"✅ *Alert Created!*\n\n"
        f"📊 *{symbol}*\n"
        f"💲 Current: {current_price:,.2f}\n"
        f"🎯 Alert: {type_text}\n\n"
        f"I'll notify you when this happens!",
        parse_mode='Markdown',
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup([
            [InlineKeyboardButton("🔔 Create Another", callback_data="new_alert")],
            [InlineKeyboardButton("📋 My Alerts", callback_data="my_alerts")]
        ])
    )
    
    context.user_data.clear()
    
    return ConversationHandler.END
```

# Idea #45: AI Financial Advisor Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

An AI-powered personal finance advisor that provides customized financial advice, budgeting recommendations, debt payoff strategies, and investment guidance based on user's financial situation.

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- Financial advisors are expensive ($100-300/hour)
- Generic advice doesn't fit personal situations
- Lack of financial literacy
- No one to ask "dumb" money questions
- Inconsistent financial planning

```
Phase 2 (Week 4-5):
```
