### Data Models

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, date
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum

class PoolStatus(Enum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    CLOSED = "closed"
    LIQUIDATING = "liquidating"

class MemberRole(Enum):
    ADMIN = "admin"
    MANAGER = "manager"
    MEMBER = "member"

class VoteType(Enum):
    BUY = "buy"
    SELL = "sell"
    HOLD = "hold"
    ADD_MEMBER = "add_member"
    REMOVE_MEMBER = "remove_member"
    CHANGE_RULES = "change_rules"
    LIQUIDATE = "liquidate"

class VoteStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    PASSED = "passed"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    EXPIRED = "expired"

class TransactionType(Enum):
    CONTRIBUTION = "contribution"
    WITHDRAWAL = "withdrawal"
    INVESTMENT_BUY = "investment_buy"
    INVESTMENT_SELL = "investment_sell"
    DIVIDEND = "dividend"
    FEE = "fee"

@dataclass
class InvestmentPool:
    id: int
    name: str
    description: str
    created_by: int
    status: PoolStatus
    total_value: Decimal
    cash_balance: Decimal
    min_contribution: Decimal
    max_members: int
    voting_threshold: float  # Percentage needed to pass (e.g., 0.51 for majority)
    vote_duration_hours: int
    lock_period_days: int  # Minimum time before withdrawal
    management_fee_pct: Decimal
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime

@dataclass
class PoolMember:
    id: int
    pool_id: int
    user_id: int
    role: MemberRole
    total_contributed: Decimal
    current_value: Decimal
    ownership_percentage: Decimal
    joined_at: datetime
    last_contribution: datetime
    can_withdraw_after: date

@dataclass
class Contribution:
    id: int
    pool_id: int
    member_id: int
    amount: Decimal
    payment_method: str
    payment_reference: str
    is_verified: bool
    verified_by: Optional[int]
    contributed_at: datetime

@dataclass
class PoolHolding:
    id: int
    pool_id: int
    asset_type: str  # stock, crypto, etf
    symbol: str
    name: str
    quantity: Decimal
    average_cost: Decimal
    current_price: Decimal
    current_value: Decimal
    unrealized_pnl: Decimal
    unrealized_pnl_pct: Decimal
    last_updated: datetime

@dataclass
class InvestmentProposal:
    id: int
    pool_id: int
    proposed_by: int
    vote_type: VoteType
    asset_symbol: Optional[str]
    asset_name: Optional[str]
    amount: Decimal
    rationale: str
    votes_for: int
    votes_against: int
    total_votes: int
    status: VoteStatus
    expires_at: datetime
    executed_at: Optional[datetime]
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class Vote:
    id: int
    proposal_id: int
    member_id: int
    vote: bool  # True = for, False = against
    weight: Decimal  # Based on ownership percentage
    voted_at: datetime

@dataclass
class PoolTransaction:
    id: int
    pool_id: int
    transaction_type: TransactionType
    member_id: Optional[int]
    asset_symbol: Optional[str]
    quantity: Optional[Decimal]
    price_per_unit: Optional[Decimal]
    total_amount: Decimal
    fee: Decimal
    notes: str
    executed_at: datetime

@dataclass
class MemberStatement:
    member_id: int
    pool_id: int
    period_start: date
    period_end: date
    opening_balance: Decimal
    contributions: Decimal
    withdrawals: Decimal
    investment_gains: Decimal
    dividends: Decimal
    fees: Decimal
    closing_balance: Decimal
    return_percentage: Decimal
```

### Pool Management Engine

```python
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple

class PoolManager:
    """Manages investment pool operations"""
    
    def __init__(self, pool_id: int):
        self.pool_id = pool_id
        self.pool = get_pool(pool_id)
    
    def create_pool(
        self,
        creator_id: int,
        name: str,
        description: str,
        min_contribution: Decimal,
        max_members: int = 20,
        voting_threshold: float = 0.51,
        vote_duration_hours: int = 48,
        lock_period_days: int = 30,
        management_fee_pct: Decimal = Decimal('0')
    ) -> InvestmentPool:
        """Create a new investment pool"""
        
        pool = InvestmentPool(
            id=0,
            name=name,
            description=description,
            created_by=creator_id,
            status=PoolStatus.ACTIVE,
            total_value=Decimal(0),
            cash_balance=Decimal(0),
            min_contribution=min_contribution,
            max_members=max_members,
            voting_threshold=voting_threshold,
            vote_duration_hours=vote_duration_hours,
            lock_period_days=lock_period_days,
            management_fee_pct=management_fee_pct,
            created_at=datetime.now(),
            updated_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        pool = save_pool(pool)
        
        # Add creator as admin member
        member = PoolMember(
            id=0,
            pool_id=pool.id,
            user_id=creator_id,
            role=MemberRole.ADMIN,
            total_contributed=Decimal(0),
            current_value=Decimal(0),
            ownership_percentage=Decimal(0),
            joined_at=datetime.now(),
            last_contribution=datetime.now(),
            can_withdraw_after=date.today() + timedelta(days=lock_period_days)
        )
        
        save_pool_member(member)
        
        return pool
    
    def add_member(self, user_id: int, invited_by: int) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Add a new member to the pool"""
        
        # Check if pool is full
        current_members = count_pool_members(self.pool_id)
        if current_members >= self.pool.max_members:
            return False, "Pool is full"
        
        # Check if user is already a member
        if is_pool_member(self.pool_id, user_id):
            return False, "User is already a member"
        
        # Check if pool requires vote for new members
        if current_members > 1:  # If more than just creator
            # Create a proposal for adding member
            self.create_proposal(
                proposed_by=invited_by,
                vote_type=VoteType.ADD_MEMBER,
                amount=Decimal(0),
                rationale=f"Add new member (User ID: {user_id})"
            )
            return True, "Member addition proposed. Waiting for vote."
        
        # Add directly if pool is new
        member = PoolMember(
            id=0,
            pool_id=self.pool_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            role=MemberRole.MEMBER,
            total_contributed=Decimal(0),
            current_value=Decimal(0),
            ownership_percentage=Decimal(0),
            joined_at=datetime.now(),
            last_contribution=datetime.now(),
            can_withdraw_after=date.today() + timedelta(days=self.pool.lock_period_days)
        )
        
        save_pool_member(member)
        return True, "Member added successfully"
    
    def process_contribution(
        self,
        member_id: int,
        amount: Decimal,
        payment_reference: str
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Process a member contribution"""
        
        member = get_pool_member(member_id)
        
        if amount < self.pool.min_contribution:
            return False, f"Minimum contribution is ${self.pool.min_contribution}"
        
        # Create contribution record
        contribution = Contribution(
            id=0,
            pool_id=self.pool_id,
            member_id=member_id,
            amount=amount,
            payment_method="manual",
            payment_reference=payment_reference,
            is_verified=False,
            verified_by=None,
            contributed_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        save_contribution(contribution)
        
        return True, "Contribution recorded. Waiting for admin verification."
    
    def verify_contribution(
        self,
        contribution_id: int,
        verified_by: int
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Verify a contribution (admin only)"""
        
        verifier = get_pool_member_by_user(self.pool_id, verified_by)
        if not verifier or verifier.role not in [MemberRole.ADMIN, MemberRole.MANAGER]:
            return False, "Only admins can verify contributions"
        
        contribution = get_contribution(contribution_id)
        if contribution.is_verified:
            return False, "Contribution already verified"
        
        # Update contribution
        contribution.is_verified = True
        contribution.verified_by = verified_by
        update_contribution(contribution)
        
        # Update member balance
        member = get_pool_member(contribution.member_id)
        member.total_contributed += contribution.amount
        member.last_contribution = datetime.now()
        member.can_withdraw_after = date.today() + timedelta(days=self.pool.lock_period_days)
        
        # Update pool cash balance
        self.pool.cash_balance += contribution.amount
        self.pool.total_value += contribution.amount
        
        # Recalculate ownership percentages
        self._recalculate_ownership()
        
        # Record transaction
        transaction = PoolTransaction(
            id=0,
            pool_id=self.pool_id,
            transaction_type=TransactionType.CONTRIBUTION,
            member_id=contribution.member_id,
            asset_symbol=None,
            quantity=None,
            price_per_unit=None,
            total_amount=contribution.amount,
            fee=Decimal(0),
            notes=f"Contribution verified by admin",
            executed_at=datetime.now()
        )
        save_transaction(transaction)
        
        update_pool_member(member)
        update_pool(self.pool)
        
        return True, f"Contribution of ${contribution.amount} verified"
    
    def _recalculate_ownership(self):
        """Recalculate ownership percentages for all members"""
        
        members = get_pool_members(self.pool_id)
        total_contributed = sum(m.total_contributed for m in members)
        
        if total_contributed == 0:
            return
        
        for member in members:
            member.ownership_percentage = (
                member.total_contributed / total_contributed * 100
            ).quantize(Decimal('0.0001'))
            
            member.current_value = (
                self.pool.total_value * member.ownership_percentage / 100
            ).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
            
            update_pool_member(member)
    
    def create_proposal(
        self,
        proposed_by: int,
        vote_type: VoteType,
        amount: Decimal,
        rationale: str,
        asset_symbol: Optional[str] = None,
        asset_name: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> InvestmentProposal:
        """Create a new investment proposal"""
        
        member = get_pool_member_by_user(self.pool_id, proposed_by)
        if not member:
            raise ValueError("Only members can create proposals")
        
        proposal = InvestmentProposal(
            id=0,
            pool_id=self.pool_id,
            proposed_by=proposed_by,
            vote_type=vote_type,
            asset_symbol=asset_symbol,
            asset_name=asset_name,
            amount=amount,
            rationale=rationale,
            votes_for=0,
            votes_against=0,
            total_votes=0,
            status=VoteStatus.PENDING,
            expires_at=datetime.now() + timedelta(hours=self.pool.vote_duration_hours),
            executed_at=None,
            created_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        return save_proposal(proposal)
    
    def cast_vote(
        self,
        proposal_id: int,
        user_id: int,
        vote_for: bool
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Cast a vote on a proposal"""
        
        proposal = get_proposal(proposal_id)
        
        if proposal.status != VoteStatus.PENDING:
            return False, "Voting has ended"
        
        if datetime.now() > proposal.expires_at:
            return False, "Voting period expired"
        
        member = get_pool_member_by_user(self.pool_id, user_id)
        if not member:
            return False, "Only members can vote"
        
        # Check if already voted
        existing_vote = get_member_vote(proposal_id, member.id)
        if existing_vote:
            return False, "Already voted on this proposal"
        
        vote = Vote(
            id=0,
            proposal_id=proposal_id,
            member_id=member.id,
            vote=vote_for,
            weight=member.ownership_percentage,
            voted_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        save_vote(vote)
        
        # Update proposal vote counts
        if vote_for:
            proposal.votes_for += 1
        else:
            proposal.votes_against += 1
        proposal.total_votes += 1
        
        update_proposal(proposal)
        
        # Check if vote can be concluded
        self._check_vote_conclusion(proposal)
        
        return True, "Vote recorded"
    
    def _check_vote_conclusion(self, proposal: InvestmentProposal):
        """Check if a vote can be concluded"""
        
        members = get_pool_members(self.pool_id)
        total_members = len(members)
        
        # Get weighted votes
        votes = get_proposal_votes(proposal.id)
        weighted_for = sum(v.weight for v in votes if v.vote)
        weighted_against = sum(v.weight for v in votes if not v.vote)
        
        total_weight = Decimal(100)  # Total ownership is always 100%
        
        # Check if passed
        if weighted_for / total_weight >= Decimal(str(self.pool.voting_threshold)):
            proposal.status = VoteStatus.PASSED
            update_proposal(proposal)
            self._execute_proposal(proposal)
        
        # Check if definitely rejected
        elif weighted_against / total_weight > Decimal(1 - self.pool.voting_threshold):
            proposal.status = VoteStatus.REJECTED
            update_proposal(proposal)
    
    def _execute_proposal(self, proposal: InvestmentProposal):
        """Execute a passed proposal"""
        
        if proposal.vote_type == VoteType.BUY:
            self._execute_buy(proposal)
        elif proposal.vote_type == VoteType.SELL:
            self._execute_sell(proposal)
        # Handle other vote types...
        
        proposal.executed_at = datetime.now()
        update_proposal(proposal)
    
    def _execute_buy(self, proposal: InvestmentProposal):
        """Execute a buy order"""
        
        if proposal.amount > self.pool.cash_balance:
            # Mark as failed
            proposal.status = VoteStatus.REJECTED
            return
        
        # Get current price (mock - would use real API)
        current_price = get_asset_price(proposal.asset_symbol)
        
        quantity = (proposal.amount / current_price).quantize(Decimal('0.0001'))
        
        # Check if we already hold this asset
        holding = get_pool_holding(self.pool_id, proposal.asset_symbol)
        
        if holding:
            # Update average cost
            total_cost = holding.average_cost * holding.quantity + proposal.amount
            holding.quantity += quantity
            holding.average_cost = total_cost / holding.quantity
            update_holding(holding)
        else:
            # Create new holding
            holding = PoolHolding(
                id=0,
                pool_id=self.pool_id,
                asset_type='stock',
                symbol=proposal.asset_symbol,
                name=proposal.asset_name,
                quantity=quantity,
                average_cost=current_price,
                current_price=current_price,
                current_value=proposal.amount,
                unrealized_pnl=Decimal(0),
                unrealized_pnl_pct=Decimal(0),
                last_updated=datetime.now()
            )
            save_holding(holding)
        
        # Update cash balance
        self.pool.cash_balance -= proposal.amount
        update_pool(self.pool)
        
        # Record transaction
        transaction = PoolTransaction(
            id=0,
            pool_id=self.pool_id,
            transaction_type=TransactionType.INVESTMENT_BUY,
            member_id=None,
            asset_symbol=proposal.asset_symbol,
            quantity=quantity,
            price_per_unit=current_price,
            total_amount=proposal.amount,
            fee=Decimal('0'),
            notes=f"Bought via proposal #{proposal.id}",
            executed_at=datetime.now()
        )
        save_transaction(transaction)
    
    def get_portfolio_summary(self) -> Dict:
        """Get complete portfolio summary"""
        
        holdings = get_pool_holdings(self.pool_id)
        
        # Update current prices
        for holding in holdings:
            current_price = get_asset_price(holding.symbol)
            holding.current_price = current_price
            holding.current_value = holding.quantity * current_price
            holding.unrealized_pnl = holding.current_value - (holding.quantity * holding.average_cost)
            holding.unrealized_pnl_pct = (
                holding.unrealized_pnl / (holding.quantity * holding.average_cost) * 100
            ) if holding.quantity > 0 else Decimal(0)
            holding.last_updated = datetime.now()
            update_holding(holding)
        
        total_invested = sum(h.quantity * h.average_cost for h in holdings)
        total_current = sum(h.current_value for h in holdings)
        total_pnl = total_current - total_invested
        total_pnl_pct = (total_pnl / total_invested * 100) if total_invested > 0 else Decimal(0)
        
        # Update pool total value
        self.pool.total_value = total_current + self.pool.cash_balance
        update_pool(self.pool)
        
        # Recalculate member values
        self._recalculate_ownership()
        
        return {
            'pool_name': self.pool.name,
            'total_value': float(self.pool.total_value),
            'cash_balance': float(self.pool.cash_balance),
            'invested_value': float(total_current),
            'total_invested_cost': float(total_invested),
            'unrealized_pnl': float(total_pnl),
            'unrealized_pnl_pct': float(total_pnl_pct),
            'holdings': [{
                'symbol': h.symbol,
                'name': h.name,
                'quantity': float(h.quantity),
                'avg_cost': float(h.average_cost),
                'current_price': float(h.current_price),
                'value': float(h.current_value),
                'pnl': float(h.unrealized_pnl),
                'pnl_pct': float(h.unrealized_pnl_pct)
            } for h in holdings],
            'member_count': count_pool_members(self.pool_id)
        }
```

### Telegram Bot Handlers

```python
from telegram import Update, InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes, ConversationHandler

# Conversation states
POOL_NAME, POOL_MIN_CONTRIBUTION, POOL_SETTINGS = range(3)
PROPOSAL_ASSET, PROPOSAL_AMOUNT, PROPOSAL_RATIONALE = range(3, 6)
CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT, CONTRIBUTION_REFERENCE = range(6, 8)

async def cmd_pool(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Main pool command - show user's pools"""
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    memberships = get_user_pool_memberships(user_id)
    
    if not memberships:
        keyboard = [
            [InlineKeyboardButton("🆕 Create Pool", callback_data="pool_create")],
            [InlineKeyboardButton("🔗 Join Pool", callback_data="pool_join")]
        ]
        
        await update.message.reply_text(
            "👥 *Investment Pools*\n\n"
            "You're not a member of any investment pools yet.\n\n"
            "Create your own pool or join an existing one!",
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        return
    
    message = "👥 *Your Investment Pools*\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    keyboard = []
    
    for membership in memberships:
        pool = get_pool(membership.pool_id)
        
        pnl = membership.current_value - membership.total_contributed
        pnl_pct = (pnl / membership.total_contributed * 100) if membership.total_contributed > 0 else Decimal(0)
        pnl_emoji = "📈" if pnl >= 0 else "📉"
        
        role_emoji = "👑" if membership.role == MemberRole.ADMIN else "👤"
        
        message += f"{role_emoji} *{pool.name}*\n"
        message += f"├ Your value: ${membership.current_value:,.2f}\n"
        message += f"├ Ownership: {membership.ownership_percentage:.2f}%\n"
        message += f"└ {pnl_emoji} P/L: ${pnl:+,.2f} ({pnl_pct:+.1f}%)\n\n"
        
        keyboard.append([
            InlineKeyboardButton(f"📊 {pool.name}", callback_data=f"pool_view_{pool.id}")
        ])
    
    keyboard.append([InlineKeyboardButton("🆕 Create New Pool", callback_data="pool_create")])
    
    await update.message.reply_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

    """View detailed pool information"""
    
    query = update.callback_query

    pool_id = int(query.data.replace("pool_view_", ""))

📊 *{summary['pool_name']}*

{pnl_emoji} *Performance:*

        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="pool_list")]

    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,

async def show_active_votes(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show active voting proposals"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    pool_id = int(query.data.replace("pool_votes_", ""))
    
    proposals = get_pending_proposals(pool_id)
    
    if not proposals:
        keyboard = [[InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data=f"pool_view_{pool_id}")]]
        await query.edit_message_text(
            "🗳️ *Active Votes*\n\nNo active proposals at the moment.",
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        return
    
    message = "🗳️ *Active Proposals*\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    keyboard = []
    
    for prop in proposals:
        time_left = prop.expires_at - datetime.now()
        hours_left = int(time_left.total_seconds() / 3600)
        
        vote_type_emoji = {
            VoteType.BUY: "📈",
            VoteType.SELL: "📉",
            VoteType.ADD_MEMBER: "👤",
            VoteType.LIQUIDATE: "💥"
        }
        
        emoji = vote_type_emoji.get(prop.vote_type, "📋")
        
        message += f"{emoji} *{prop.vote_type.value.upper()}*\n"
        if prop.asset_symbol:
            message += f"├ Asset: {prop.asset_symbol}\n"
        message += f"├ Amount: ${prop.amount:,.2f}\n"
        message += f"├ Votes: ✅ {prop.votes_for} | ❌ {prop.votes_against}\n"
        message += f"└ ⏰ {hours_left}h left\n\n"
        
        keyboard.append([
            InlineKeyboardButton(f"Vote on #{prop.id}", callback_data=f"pool_vote_{prop.id}")
        ])
    
    keyboard.append([InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data=f"pool_view_{pool_id}")])
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def show_vote_detail(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show proposal detail and voting options"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    proposal_id = int(query.data.replace("pool_vote_", ""))
    proposal = get_proposal(proposal_id)
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    member = get_pool_member_by_user(proposal.pool_id, user_id)
    
    # Check if already voted
    existing_vote = get_member_vote(proposal_id, member.id)
    
    proposer = get_user(proposal.proposed_by)
    
    time_left = proposal.expires_at - datetime.now()
    hours_left = max(0, int(time_left.total_seconds() / 3600))
    
    message = f"""
🗳️ *Proposal #{proposal.id}*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📋 *Type:* {proposal.vote_type.value.title()}
{'📈 *Asset:* ' + proposal.asset_symbol if proposal.asset_symbol else ''}
💰 *Amount:* ${proposal.amount:,.2f}

📝 *Rationale:*
{proposal.rationale}

👤 *Proposed by:* {proposer.first_name}
⏰ *Time remaining:* {hours_left} hours

📊 *Current Votes:*
├ ✅ For: {proposal.votes_for}
└ ❌ Against: {proposal.votes_against}
"""
    
    if existing_vote:
        vote_text = "✅ FOR" if existing_vote.vote else "❌ AGAINST"
        message += f"\n✔️ *You voted:* {vote_text}"
        keyboard = [[InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data=f"pool_votes_{proposal.pool_id}")]]
    else:
        keyboard = [
            [
                InlineKeyboardButton("✅ Vote FOR", callback_data=f"cast_vote_{proposal_id}_for"),
                InlineKeyboardButton("❌ Vote AGAINST", callback_data=f"cast_vote_{proposal_id}_against")
            ],
            [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data=f"pool_votes_{proposal.pool_id}")]
        ]
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def handle_vote(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle vote casting"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    
    parts = query.data.split("_")
    proposal_id = int(parts[2])
    vote_for = parts[3] == "for"
    
    proposal = get_proposal(proposal_id)
    manager = PoolManager(proposal.pool_id)
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    success, message = manager.cast_vote(proposal_id, user_id, vote_for)
    
    await query.answer(message)
    
    if success:
        # Refresh the proposal view
        await show_vote_detail(update, context)

async def start_contribute(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Start contribution flow"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    pool_id = int(query.data.replace("pool_contribute_", ""))
    pool = get_pool(pool_id)
    
    context.user_data['contributing_to'] = pool_id
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        f"💰 *Contribute to {pool.name}*\n\n"
        f"Minimum contribution: ${pool.min_contribution:,.2f}\n\n"
        "Enter the amount you want to contribute:",
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )
    
    return CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT

async def handle_contribution_amount(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle contribution amount input"""
    
    try:
        amount = Decimal(update.message.text.replace('$', '').replace(',', ''))
        
        pool_id = context.user_data['contributing_to']
        pool = get_pool(pool_id)
        
        if amount < pool.min_contribution:
            await update.message.reply_text(
                f"❌ Minimum contribution is ${pool.min_contribution:,.2f}. "
                "Please enter a valid amount:"
            )
            return CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT
        
        context.user_data['contribution_amount'] = amount
        
        # Show payment instructions
        await update.message.reply_text(
            f"💳 *Payment Instructions*\n\n"
            f"Please transfer ${amount:,.2f} to:\n\n"
            f"*Bank:* Example Bank\n"
            f"*Account:* 1234567890\n"
            f"*Name:* Pool Treasury\n\n"
            f"After payment, enter your payment reference/transaction ID:",
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        
        return CONTRIBUTION_REFERENCE
        
    except:
        await update.message.reply_text(
            "❌ Invalid amount. Please enter a number (e.g., 500):"
        )
        return CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT

async def handle_contribution_reference(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle payment reference and submit contribution"""
    
    reference = update.message.text.strip()
    
    pool_id = context.user_data['contributing_to']
    amount = context.user_data['contribution_amount']
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    member = get_pool_member_by_user(pool_id, user_id)
    
    manager = PoolManager(pool_id)
    success, message = manager.process_contribution(member.id, amount, reference)
    
    if success:
        # Notify admins
        await notify_pool_admins(
            pool_id,
            f"💰 New contribution of ${amount:,.2f} pending verification\n"
            f"Reference: {reference}"
        )
        
        keyboard = [[InlineKeyboardButton("📊 Back to Pool", callback_data=f"pool_view_{pool_id}")]]
        
        await update.message.reply_text(
            "✅ *Contribution Submitted!*\n\n"
            f"Amount: ${amount:,.2f}\n"
            f"Reference: {reference}\n\n"
            "An admin will verify your payment shortly.",
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
    else:
        await update.message.reply_text(f"❌ {message}")
    
    return ConversationHandler.END

# Scheduled tasks
async def check_expired_votes(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Check and expire old votes"""
    
    expired = get_expired_proposals()
    
    for proposal in expired:
        proposal.status = VoteStatus.EXPIRED
        update_proposal(proposal)
        
        # Notify pool members
        await notify_pool_members(
            proposal.pool_id,
            f"🗳️ Proposal #{proposal.id} has expired without passing."
        )

async def update_pool_prices(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Update all pool holding prices"""
    
    pools = get_active_pools()
    
    for pool in pools:
        manager = PoolManager(pool.id)
        manager.get_portfolio_summary()  # This updates prices
```

        ])
    
    keyboard.append([
        InlineKeyboardButton("✅ Complete Lesson", callback_data=f"complete_lesson_{lesson_id}")
    ])
    
    # Navigation
    prev_lesson = get_previous_lesson(course.id, lesson.order)

    if next_lesson:

    if nav_buttons:
        keyboard.append(nav_buttons)
    
    keyboard.append([InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Course", callback_data=f"course_{course.id}")])
    
    if query:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            message,
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
    else:
        await update.message.reply_text(

            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),

        )

async def show_quiz_question(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show current quiz question"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    
    quiz_state = context.user_data.get('current_quiz')
    if not quiz_state:
        await query.edit_message_text("Quiz session expired. Please start again.")
        return
    
    quiz = get_quiz(quiz_state['quiz_id'])
    q_index = quiz_state['current_question']
    
    if q_index >= len(quiz.questions):
        # Quiz completed
        await submit_quiz_answers(update, context)
        return
    
    question = quiz.questions[q_index]
    
    message = f"📝 *Quiz*\n"
    message += f"Question {q_index + 1} of {len(quiz.questions)}\n"
    message += "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    message += f"*{question['question']}*\n\n"
    
    keyboard = []
    for i, option in enumerate(question['options']):
        keyboard.append([
            InlineKeyboardButton(f"{chr(65+i)}. {option}", 
                               callback_data=f"answer_{quiz_state['quiz_id']}_{i}")
        ])
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def handle_quiz_answer(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle quiz answer selection"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    parts = query.data.split("_")
    quiz_id = int(parts[1])
    answer = int(parts[2])
    
    quiz_state = context.user_data.get('current_quiz')
    if not quiz_state or quiz_state['quiz_id'] != quiz_id:
        await query.edit_message_text("Quiz session expired.")
        return
    
    # Store answer
    quiz_state['answers'].append(answer)
    quiz_state['current_question'] += 1
    
    # Show next question or results
    await show_quiz_question(update, context)

# Idea #53: IPO and Primary Offering Alert Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

A bot that tracks upcoming IPOs (Initial Public Offerings), primary stock offerings, and new investment opportunities. Provides alerts, analysis, and helps users never miss out on investment opportunities in new listings.

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- Missing out on IPO opportunities due to lack of awareness
- No centralized source for upcoming offerings
- Complex IPO application processes
- Difficulty evaluating new companies going public
- Late information reaching retail investors
- Missing allocation deadlines

## ⭐ Key Features

```
Phase 1 (Week 1-2):
├── IPO calendar tracking
├── Real-time new listing alerts
├── Basic company information
├── Key dates reminders
├── Price range updates
├── Subscription period alerts
└── Regional market support

Phase 2 (Week 3-4):
├── IPO analysis reports
├── Historical performance data
├── Sector comparison
├── Broker integration info
├── Watchlist management
├── Price target predictions
├── Post-IPO tracking
└── SPAC tracking
```

## 👨‍💻 Complete Implementation

### Data Models

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, date
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum

class IPOStatus(Enum):
    UPCOMING = "upcoming"
    OPEN = "open"  # Subscription period open
    CLOSED = "closed"  # Subscription closed
    LISTED = "listed"
    POSTPONED = "postponed"
    WITHDRAWN = "withdrawn"

class OfferingType(Enum):
    IPO = "ipo"
    FPO = "fpo"  # Follow-on Public Offering
    OFS = "ofs"  # Offer for Sale
    RIGHTS = "rights"
    SPAC = "spac"
    DIRECT_LISTING = "direct_listing"

class Market(Enum):
    NYSE = "nyse"
    NASDAQ = "nasdaq"
    BSE = "bse"
    NSE = "nse"
    LSE = "lse"
    TSE = "tse"
    HKEX = "hkex"

@dataclass
class IPO:
    id: int
    company_name: str
    ticker_symbol: str
    offering_type: OfferingType
    market: Market
    status: IPOStatus
    
    # Dates
    filing_date: Optional[date]
    subscription_start: Optional[date]
    subscription_end: Optional[date]
    allotment_date: Optional[date]
    listing_date: Optional[date]
    
    # Pricing
    price_range_low: Optional[Decimal]
    price_range_high: Optional[Decimal]
    final_price: Optional[Decimal]
    lot_size: int
    min_investment: Decimal
    
    # Company info
    sector: str
    industry: str
    description: str
    founded_year: int
    headquarters: str
    website: str
    
    # Financials (latest year)
    revenue: Optional[Decimal]
    net_income: Optional[Decimal]
    total_assets: Optional[Decimal]
    
    # Offering details
    shares_offered: int
    issue_size: Decimal
    market_cap_at_price: Decimal
    
    # Documents
    prospectus_url: Optional[str]
    red_herring_url: Optional[str]
    
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime

@dataclass
class IPOSubscription:
    id: int
    ipo_id: int
    category: str  # retail, hni, qib
    subscription_times: Decimal  # e.g., 3.5x oversubscribed
    applications_received: int
    shares_applied: int
    updated_at: datetime

@dataclass
class IPOPerformance:
    id: int
    ipo_id: int
    listing_price: Decimal
    listing_gain_pct: Decimal
    day1_close: Decimal
    day1_return_pct: Decimal
    week1_return_pct: Optional[Decimal]
    month1_return_pct: Optional[Decimal]
    current_price: Decimal
    total_return_pct: Decimal
    last_updated: datetime

@dataclass
class UserIPOWatchlist:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    ipo_id: int
    notify_on_open: bool
    notify_on_allotment: bool
    notify_on_listing: bool
    notes: str
    added_at: datetime

@dataclass
class IPOAlert:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    ipo_id: int
    alert_type: str  # new_ipo, status_change, price_update, subscription_open, listing
    message: str
    sent_at: datetime
    was_read: bool

@dataclass
class UserIPOPreferences:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    markets: List[Market]
    sectors: List[str]
    min_issue_size: Optional[Decimal]
    max_issue_size: Optional[Decimal]
    alert_new_filings: bool
    alert_subscription_open: bool
    alert_listing_day: bool
    daily_digest: bool
    created_at: datetime
```

### IPO Data Service

```python
import aiohttp
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
from typing import List, Dict, Optional
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

class IPODataService:
    """Service to fetch and update IPO data"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.sources = {
            Market.NYSE: 'https://www.nyse.com/ipo-center/filings',
            Market.NASDAQ: 'https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/ipos',
            Market.NSE: 'https://www.nseindia.com/market-data/ipo-current-issues',
        }
    
    async def fetch_upcoming_ipos(self, market: Market) -> List[IPO]:
        """Fetch upcoming IPOs from market"""
        
        if market == Market.NASDAQ:
            return await self._fetch_nasdaq_ipos()
        elif market == Market.NYSE:
            return await self._fetch_nyse_ipos()
        elif market in [Market.NSE, Market.BSE]:
            return await self._fetch_indian_ipos()
        
        return []
    
    async def _fetch_nasdaq_ipos(self) -> List[IPO]:
        """Fetch IPOs from NASDAQ API"""
        
        url = "https://api.nasdaq.com/api/ipo/calendar"
        
        headers = {
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0',
            'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
        
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
            async with session.get(url, headers=headers) as response:
                if response.status != 200:
                    return []
                
                data = await response.json()
                ipos = []
                
                for item in data.get('data', {}).get('upcoming', {}).get('rows', []):
                    ipo = IPO(
                        id=0,
                        company_name=item.get('companyName', ''),
                        ticker_symbol=item.get('proposedTickerSymbol', ''),
                        offering_type=OfferingType.IPO,
                        market=Market.NASDAQ,
                        status=IPOStatus.UPCOMING,
                        filing_date=self._parse_date(item.get('filedDate')),
                        subscription_start=None,
                        subscription_end=None,
                        allotment_date=None,
                        listing_date=self._parse_date(item.get('expectedPriceDate')),
                        price_range_low=self._parse_decimal(item.get('proposedSharePrice', '').split('-')[0]),
                        price_range_high=self._parse_decimal(item.get('proposedSharePrice', '').split('-')[-1]),
                        final_price=None,
                        lot_size=1,
                        min_investment=Decimal(0),
                        sector=item.get('sector', 'Unknown'),
                        industry=item.get('industry', 'Unknown'),
                        description='',
                        founded_year=0,
                        headquarters='USA',
                        website='',
                        revenue=None,
                        net_income=None,
                        total_assets=None,
                        shares_offered=self._parse_int(item.get('sharesOffered', '0')),
                        issue_size=self._parse_decimal(item.get('dollarValueOfSharesOffered', '0')),
                        market_cap_at_price=Decimal(0),
                        prospectus_url=None,
                        red_herring_url=None,
                        created_at=datetime.now(),
                        updated_at=datetime.now()
                    )
                    ipos.append(ipo)
                
                return ipos
    
    async def _fetch_indian_ipos(self) -> List[IPO]:
        """Fetch IPOs from Indian markets (NSE/BSE)"""
        
        # Using chittorgarh API (popular IPO tracking site)
        url = "https://www.chittorgarh.com/ipo/ipo_dashboard.asp"
        
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
            async with session.get(url) as response:
                if response.status != 200:
                    return []
                
                html = await response.text()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
                
                ipos = []
                
                # Parse IPO tables
                tables = soup.find_all('table', class_='table')
                
                for table in tables:
                    rows = table.find_all('tr')[1:]  # Skip header
                    
                    for row in rows:
                        cols = row.find_all('td')
                        if len(cols) >= 5:
                            ipo = IPO(
                                id=0,
                                company_name=cols[0].get_text(strip=True),
                                ticker_symbol='',
                                offering_type=OfferingType.IPO,
                                market=Market.NSE,
                                status=self._parse_ipo_status(cols[4].get_text(strip=True)),
                                filing_date=None,
                                subscription_start=self._parse_date(cols[1].get_text(strip=True)),
                                subscription_end=self._parse_date(cols[2].get_text(strip=True)),
                                allotment_date=None,
                                listing_date=self._parse_date(cols[3].get_text(strip=True)),
                                price_range_low=None,
                                price_range_high=None,
                                final_price=None,
                                lot_size=0,
                                min_investment=Decimal(0),
                                sector='',
                                industry='',
                                description='',
                                founded_year=0,
                                headquarters='India',
                                website='',
                                revenue=None,
                                net_income=None,
                                total_assets=None,
                                shares_offered=0,
                                issue_size=Decimal(0),
                                market_cap_at_price=Decimal(0),
                                prospectus_url=None,
                                red_herring_url=None,
                                created_at=datetime.now(),
                                updated_at=datetime.now()
                            )
                            ipos.append(ipo)
                
                return ipos
    
    def _parse_date(self, date_str: Optional[str]) -> Optional[date]:
        """Parse date from string"""
        if not date_str:
            return None
        
        formats = ['%Y-%m-%d', '%m/%d/%Y', '%d-%m-%Y', '%b %d, %Y']
        
        for fmt in formats:
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(date_str.strip(), fmt).date()
            except ValueError:
                continue
        
        return None
    
    def _parse_decimal(self, value: str) -> Optional[Decimal]:
        """Parse decimal from string"""
        try:
            clean = value.replace('$', '').replace(',', '').replace('₹', '').strip()
            return Decimal(clean) if clean else None
        except:
            return None
    
    def _parse_int(self, value: str) -> int:
        """Parse integer from string"""
        try:
            clean = value.replace(',', '').strip()
            return int(clean) if clean else 0
        except:
            return 0
    
    def _parse_ipo_status(self, status_str: str) -> IPOStatus:
        """Parse IPO status from string"""
        status_lower = status_str.lower()
        
        if 'open' in status_lower:
            return IPOStatus.OPEN
        elif 'upcoming' in status_lower or 'coming' in status_lower:
            return IPOStatus.UPCOMING
        elif 'listed' in status_lower:
            return IPOStatus.LISTED
        elif 'closed' in status_lower:
            return IPOStatus.CLOSED
        else:
            return IPOStatus.UPCOMING
    
    async def get_ipo_details(self, ipo_id: int) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Get detailed IPO information"""
        
        ipo = get_ipo(ipo_id)
        if not ipo:
            return None
        
        # Get subscription data if available
        subscription = get_ipo_subscription(ipo_id)
        
        # Get performance if listed
        performance = get_ipo_performance(ipo_id) if ipo.status == IPOStatus.LISTED else None
        
        return {
            'ipo': ipo,
            'subscription': subscription,
            'performance': performance
        }
    
    async def update_all_ipos(self):
        """Update IPO data from all sources"""
        
        for market in [Market.NASDAQ, Market.NYSE, Market.NSE]:
            try:
                ipos = await self.fetch_upcoming_ipos(market)
                
                for ipo in ipos:
                    existing = get_ipo_by_name_and_market(ipo.company_name, market)
                    
                    if existing:
                        # Update existing IPO
                        ipo.id = existing.id
                        update_ipo(ipo)
                    else:
                        # New IPO - save and notify
                        saved_ipo = save_ipo(ipo)
                        await self._notify_new_ipo(saved_ipo)
            
            except Exception as e:
                log_error(f"Error updating IPOs for {market}: {e}")
    
    async def _notify_new_ipo(self, ipo: IPO):
        """Notify users about new IPO"""
        
        users = get_users_interested_in_market(ipo.market)
        
        for user in users:
            prefs = get_user_ipo_preferences(user.id)
            
            # Check if user wants this type of notification
            if not prefs.alert_new_filings:
                continue
            
            # Check sector preference
            if prefs.sectors and ipo.sector not in prefs.sectors:
                continue
            
            # Create alert
            alert = IPOAlert(
                id=0,
                user_id=user.id,
                ipo_id=ipo.id,
                alert_type='new_ipo',
                message=f"New IPO Filed: {ipo.company_name}",
                sent_at=datetime.now(),
                was_read=False
            )
            save_ipo_alert(alert)


class IPOAnalyzer:
    """Analyze IPO opportunities"""
    
    def analyze_ipo(self, ipo: IPO) -> Dict:
        """Generate analysis report for an IPO"""
        
        analysis = {
            'valuation_score': self._calculate_valuation_score(ipo),
            'financials_score': self._calculate_financials_score(ipo),
            'market_conditions': self._assess_market_conditions(ipo),
            'sector_outlook': self._get_sector_outlook(ipo.sector),
            'risks': self._identify_risks(ipo),
            'strengths': self._identify_strengths(ipo),
            'recommendation': '',
            'overall_score': 0
        }
        
        # Calculate overall score
        analysis['overall_score'] = (
            analysis['valuation_score'] * 0.3 +
            analysis['financials_score'] * 0.3 +
            analysis['market_conditions'] * 0.2 +
            analysis['sector_outlook'] * 0.2
        )
        
        # Generate recommendation
        if analysis['overall_score'] >= 70:
            analysis['recommendation'] = "Strong Consider"
        elif analysis['overall_score'] >= 50:
            analysis['recommendation'] = "Moderate"
        else:
            analysis['recommendation'] = "Caution Advised"
        
        return analysis
    
    def _calculate_valuation_score(self, ipo: IPO) -> float:
        """Calculate valuation score (0-100)"""
        
        score = 50  # Base score
        
        if ipo.revenue and ipo.market_cap_at_price:
            # Price to Sales ratio
            ps_ratio = float(ipo.market_cap_at_price / ipo.revenue)
            
            if ps_ratio < 5:
                score += 20
            elif ps_ratio < 10:
                score += 10
            elif ps_ratio > 20:
                score -= 20
        
        return max(0, min(100, score))
    
    def _calculate_financials_score(self, ipo: IPO) -> float:
        """Calculate financials score (0-100)"""
        
        score = 50
        
        if ipo.revenue and ipo.net_income:
            # Profitability
            if ipo.net_income > 0:
                score += 25
                
                # Profit margin
                margin = float(ipo.net_income / ipo.revenue)
                if margin > 0.2:
                    score += 15
                elif margin > 0.1:
                    score += 10
            else:
                score -= 10
        
        return max(0, min(100, score))
    
    def _assess_market_conditions(self, ipo: IPO) -> float:
        """Assess current market conditions (0-100)"""
        
        # This would use real market data
        # Simplified version
        return 60  # Neutral market
    
    def _get_sector_outlook(self, sector: str) -> float:
        """Get sector outlook score (0-100)"""
        
        # Hot sectors get higher scores
        hot_sectors = ['Technology', 'Healthcare', 'Clean Energy', 'AI', 'Fintech']
        neutral_sectors = ['Consumer', 'Industrial', 'Materials']
        cold_sectors = ['Traditional Energy', 'Retail']
        
        if sector in hot_sectors:
            return 75
        elif sector in neutral_sectors:
            return 50
        elif sector in cold_sectors:
            return 35
        else:
            return 50
    
    def _identify_risks(self, ipo: IPO) -> List[str]:
        """Identify potential risks"""
        
        risks = []
        
        if ipo.net_income and ipo.net_income < 0:
            risks.append("Company is not profitable")
        
        if ipo.founded_year and (datetime.now().year - ipo.founded_year) < 3:
            risks.append("Young company with limited track record")
        
        if ipo.issue_size and ipo.issue_size > Decimal('1000000000'):
            risks.append("Large offering may pressure stock price")
        
        return risks
    
    def _identify_strengths(self, ipo: IPO) -> List[str]:
        """Identify potential strengths"""
        
        strengths = []
        
        if ipo.revenue and ipo.revenue > Decimal('100000000'):
            strengths.append("Strong revenue base")
        
        if ipo.net_income and ipo.net_income > 0:
            strengths.append("Profitable company")
        
        if ipo.sector in ['Technology', 'Healthcare']:
            strengths.append("Growing sector")
        
        return strengths
    
    def get_historical_performance(self, sector: str, months: int = 12) -> Dict:
        """Get historical IPO performance in sector"""
        
        past_ipos = get_listed_ipos_in_sector(sector, months)
        
        if not past_ipos:
            return {'message': 'Insufficient data'}
        
        performances = [get_ipo_performance(ipo.id) for ipo in past_ipos]
        performances = [p for p in performances if p]
        
        if not performances:
            return {'message': 'No performance data available'}
        
        avg_listing_gain = sum(p.listing_gain_pct for p in performances) / len(performances)
        avg_month_return = sum(p.month1_return_pct or 0 for p in performances) / len(performances)
        
        positive_listings = sum(1 for p in performances if p.listing_gain_pct > 0)
        
        return {
            'ipos_analyzed': len(performances),
            'avg_listing_gain': float(avg_listing_gain),
            'avg_1month_return': float(avg_month_return),
            'positive_listing_pct': positive_listings / len(performances) * 100,
            'best_performer': max(performances, key=lambda p: p.listing_gain_pct),
            'worst_performer': min(performances, key=lambda p: p.listing_gain_pct)
        }

# Idea #54: Bank Loan Comparison Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

A comprehensive bot that compares loan products from multiple banks, calculates EMIs, helps users find the best rates, and guides them through the loan application process.

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- Difficult to compare loans across multiple banks
- Hidden fees and charges not disclosed upfront
- Complex EMI calculations
- Not knowing eligibility before applying
- Time wasted visiting multiple banks
- Missing promotional rates and offers

## ⭐ Key Features

```
Phase 1 (Week 1-2):
├── Loan type selection
│   ├── Home loan
│   ├── Personal loan
│   ├── Car loan
│   └── Education loan
├── EMI calculator
├── Multi-bank comparison
├── Interest rate tracker
├── Eligibility checker
└── Basic documentation list

Phase 2 (Week 3-4):
├── Pre-qualification check
├── Document upload guidance
├── Rate alerts
├── Refinancing calculator
├── Balance transfer analysis
├── Bank offer notifications
├── Application tracking
└── Customer reviews integration
```

## 👨‍💻 Implementation

### Loan Calculation Engine

```python
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from typing import List, Dict, Tuple
import math

class LoanCalculator:
    """EMI and loan calculations"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def calculate_emi(
        principal: Decimal,
        annual_rate: Decimal,
        tenure_months: int
    ) -> Decimal:
        """Calculate EMI using standard formula"""
        
        if annual_rate == 0:
            return principal / tenure_months
        
        monthly_rate = annual_rate / 12 / 100
        
        # EMI = P * r * (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1)
        r = float(monthly_rate)
        n = tenure_months
        P = float(principal)
        
        emi = P * r * math.pow(1 + r, n) / (math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1)
        
        return Decimal(str(emi)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
    
    @staticmethod
    def calculate_total_interest(
        principal: Decimal,
        emi: Decimal,
        tenure_months: int
    ) -> Decimal:
        """Calculate total interest payable"""
        
        total_payment = emi * tenure_months
        return (total_payment - principal).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
    
    @staticmethod
    def calculate_total_cost(
        principal: Decimal,
        emi: Decimal,
        tenure_months: int,
        processing_fee: Decimal
    ) -> Decimal:
        """Calculate total cost of loan including fees"""
        
        total_payment = emi * tenure_months
        return (total_payment + processing_fee).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
    
    @staticmethod
    def generate_amortization_schedule(
        principal: Decimal,
        annual_rate: Decimal,
        tenure_months: int
    ) -> List[Dict]:
        """Generate month-by-month amortization schedule"""
        
        schedule = []
        emi = LoanCalculator.calculate_emi(principal, annual_rate, tenure_months)
        monthly_rate = annual_rate / 12 / 100
        balance = principal
        
        for month in range(1, tenure_months + 1):
            interest_payment = (balance * monthly_rate).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
            principal_payment = emi - interest_payment
            balance = balance - principal_payment
            
            schedule.append({
                'month': month,
                'emi': float(emi),
                'principal': float(principal_payment),
                'interest': float(interest_payment),
                'balance': float(max(balance, Decimal(0)))
            })
        
        return schedule
    
    @staticmethod
    def calculate_eligibility(
        monthly_income: Decimal,
        existing_emis: Decimal,
        loan_type: LoanType
    ) -> Dict:
        """Calculate loan eligibility"""
        
        # FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio) limits by loan type
        foir_limits = {
            LoanType.HOME: Decimal('0.50'),
            LoanType.PERSONAL: Decimal('0.40'),
            LoanType.CAR: Decimal('0.45'),
            LoanType.EDUCATION: Decimal('0.50'),
            LoanType.BUSINESS: Decimal('0.55'),
        }
        
        max_foir = foir_limits.get(loan_type, Decimal('0.45'))
        
        # Available income for new EMI
        available_for_emi = (monthly_income * max_foir) - existing_emis
        
        if available_for_emi <= 0:
            return {
                'eligible': False,
                'max_emi': Decimal(0),
                'reason': 'Existing EMIs exceed FOIR limit'
            }
        
        return {
            'eligible': True,
            'max_emi': available_for_emi.quantize(Decimal('0.01')),
            'current_foir': ((existing_emis / monthly_income) * 100).quantize(Decimal('0.01')),
            'max_foir': max_foir * 100
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def estimate_max_loan(
        max_emi: Decimal,
        annual_rate: Decimal,
        tenure_months: int
    ) -> Decimal:
        """Estimate maximum loan amount based on EMI capacity"""
        
        if annual_rate == 0:
            return max_emi * tenure_months
        
        monthly_rate = float(annual_rate / 12 / 100)
        n = tenure_months
        emi = float(max_emi)
        
        # P = EMI * ((1+r)^n - 1) / (r * (1+r)^n)
        principal = emi * (math.pow(1 + monthly_rate, n) - 1) / (monthly_rate * math.pow(1 + monthly_rate, n))

class LoanComparisonEngine:
    """Compare loans across multiple banks"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.calculator = LoanCalculator()
    
    def compare_loans(
        self,
        loan_type: LoanType,
        loan_amount: Decimal,
        tenure_months: int,
        user_profile: Optional[UserLoanProfile] = None
    ) -> List[Dict]:
        """Compare loan products from all banks"""
        
        # Get all active loan products for this type
        products = get_loan_products_by_type(loan_type)
        
        comparisons = []
        
        for product in products:
            # Check if amount is within product limits
            if loan_amount < product.min_amount or loan_amount > product.max_amount:
                continue
            
            # Check if tenure is within limits
            if tenure_months < product.min_tenure_months or tenure_months > product.max_tenure_months:
                continue
            
            # Check eligibility if user profile provided
            if user_profile:
                eligible, reason = self._check_eligibility(product, user_profile)
                if not eligible:
                    continue
            
            bank = get_bank(product.bank_id)
            
            # Calculate for both min and max rates
            emi_min = self.calculator.calculate_emi(
                loan_amount, product.interest_rate_min, tenure_months
            )
            emi_max = self.calculator.calculate_emi(
                loan_amount, product.interest_rate_max, tenure_months
            )
            
            # Use average rate for comparison
            avg_rate = (product.interest_rate_min + product.interest_rate_max) / 2
            emi_avg = self.calculator.calculate_emi(loan_amount, avg_rate, tenure_months)
            
            # Calculate processing fee
            processing_fee = self._calculate_processing_fee(product, loan_amount)
            
            # Total interest
            total_interest = self.calculator.calculate_total_interest(
                loan_amount, emi_avg, tenure_months
            )
            
            # Total cost
            total_cost = self.calculator.calculate_total_cost(
                loan_amount, emi_avg, tenure_months, processing_fee
            )
            
            comparisons.append({
                'product_id': product.id,
                'bank_name': bank.name,
                'bank_logo': bank.logo_url,
                'bank_rating': bank.avg_rating,
                'product_name': product.product_name,
                'interest_rate_min': float(product.interest_rate_min),
                'interest_rate_max': float(product.interest_rate_max),
                'interest_type': product.interest_type.value,
                'emi_range': {
                    'min': float(emi_min),
                    'max': float(emi_max),
                    'avg': float(emi_avg)
                },
                'processing_fee': float(processing_fee),
                'total_interest': float(total_interest),
                'total_cost': float(total_cost),
                'prepayment_charges': product.prepayment_charges,
                'special_features': product.special_features,
                'is_featured': product.is_featured
            })
        
        # Sort by total cost (lowest first)
        comparisons.sort(key=lambda x: x['total_cost'])
        
        # Add ranking
        for i, comp in enumerate(comparisons):
            comp['rank'] = i + 1
            
            # Calculate savings compared to highest cost option
            if comparisons:
                highest_cost = comparisons[-1]['total_cost']
                comp['savings_vs_highest'] = highest_cost - comp['total_cost']
        
        return comparisons
    
    def _calculate_processing_fee(
        self, 
        product: LoanProduct, 
        loan_amount: Decimal
    ) -> Decimal:
        """Calculate processing fee"""
        
        fee = loan_amount * product.processing_fee_pct / 100
        
        # Apply min/max limits
        if fee < product.processing_fee_min:
            fee = product.processing_fee_min
        elif fee > product.processing_fee_max:
            fee = product.processing_fee_max
        
        return fee.quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
    
    def _check_eligibility(
        self, 
        product: LoanProduct, 
        profile: UserLoanProfile
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Check if user is eligible for this product"""
        
        criteria = product.eligibility_criteria
        
        # Check minimum income
        if 'min_income' in criteria:
            if profile.monthly_income < Decimal(str(criteria['min_income'])):
                return False, "Income below minimum requirement"
        
        # Check age
        if 'min_age' in criteria:
            if profile.age < criteria['min_age']:
                return False, "Below minimum age"
        
        if 'max_age' in criteria:
            if profile.age > criteria['max_age']:
                return False, "Above maximum age"
        
        # Check employment type
        if 'employment_types' in criteria:
            if profile.employment_type.value not in criteria['employment_types']:
                return False, "Employment type not eligible"
        
        # Check credit score
        if 'min_credit_score' in criteria and profile.credit_score:
            if profile.credit_score < criteria['min_credit_score']:
                return False, "Credit score below requirement"
        
        # Check work experience
        if 'min_experience_years' in criteria:
            if profile.work_experience_years < criteria['min_experience_years']:
                return False, "Insufficient work experience"
        
        return True, "Eligible"
    
    def calculate_refinancing_benefit(
        self,
        current_outstanding: Decimal,
        current_rate: Decimal,
        current_emi: Decimal,
        remaining_months: int,
        new_rate: Decimal,
        new_tenure_months: Optional[int] = None
    ) -> Dict:
        """Calculate benefit of refinancing to a new loan"""
        
        if new_tenure_months is None:
            new_tenure_months = remaining_months
        
        # Current loan total remaining payment
        current_total_remaining = current_emi * remaining_months
        
        # New loan calculations
        new_emi = self.calculator.calculate_emi(
            current_outstanding, new_rate, new_tenure_months
        )
        new_total_payment = new_emi * new_tenure_months
        
        # Savings
        savings = current_total_remaining - new_total_payment
        monthly_savings = current_emi - new_emi
        
        # Break-even (considering typical balance transfer costs)
        transfer_cost = current_outstanding * Decimal('0.005')  # 0.5% typical
        
        if monthly_savings > 0:
            break_even_months = int(transfer_cost / monthly_savings) + 1
        else:
            break_even_months = None
        
        return {
            'current_emi': float(current_emi),
            'new_emi': float(new_emi),
            'monthly_savings': float(monthly_savings),
            'total_savings': float(savings),
            'transfer_cost_estimate': float(transfer_cost),
            'net_savings': float(savings - transfer_cost),
            'break_even_months': break_even_months,
            'recommendation': 'Refinance' if savings > transfer_cost else 'Stay with current'
        }


class RateTracker:
    """Track and alert on interest rate changes"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.rate_history = {}
    
    def record_rate(self, product_id: int, rate: Decimal):
        """Record current rate for tracking"""
        
        if product_id not in self.rate_history:
            self.rate_history[product_id] = []
        
        self.rate_history[product_id].append({
            'rate': float(rate),
            'date': datetime.now().isoformat()
        })
    
    def get_rate_trend(self, product_id: int, days: int = 30) -> Dict:
        """Get rate trend for a product"""
        
        history = get_rate_history(product_id, days)
        
        if len(history) < 2:
            return {'trend': 'stable', 'change': 0}
        
        first_rate = history[0]['rate']
        last_rate = history[-1]['rate']
        change = last_rate - first_rate
        
        if change < -0.1:
            trend = 'decreasing'
        elif change > 0.1:
            trend = 'increasing'
        else:
            trend = 'stable'
        
        return {
            'trend': trend,
            'change': change,
            'first_rate': first_rate,
            'last_rate': last_rate,
            'data_points': len(history)
        }
    
    async def check_rate_alerts(self):
        """Check all active rate alerts and notify users"""
        
        alerts = get_active_rate_alerts()
        
        for alert in alerts:
            products = get_loan_products_by_type(alert.loan_type)
            
            for product in products:
                # Check if this bank is in the alert's bank list
                if alert.banks and product.bank_id not in alert.banks:
                    continue
                
                # Check if rate is at or below target
                if product.interest_rate_min <= alert.target_rate:
                    await self._send_rate_alert(alert, product)
    
    async def _send_rate_alert(self, alert: RateAlert, product: LoanProduct):
        """Send rate alert notification"""
        
        bank = get_bank(product.bank_id)
        
        message = f"🔔 *Rate Alert!*\n\n"
        message += f"🏦 *{bank.name}*\n"
        message += f"📋 {product.product_name}\n"
        message += f"💰 Rate: {product.interest_rate_min}% - {product.interest_rate_max}%\n\n"
        message += f"Your target: {alert.target_rate}%\n"
        message += f"✅ Current rate meets your target!"
        
        # Send notification
        user = get_user(alert.user_id)
        await send_telegram_message(user.telegram_id, message)
        
        # Log the alert
        log_rate_alert_sent(alert.id, product.id)

async def handle_loan_amount(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle loan amount input"""
    
    text = update.message.text.strip().upper()
    
    # Parse amount (handle L for lakhs, Cr for crores)
    try:
        if 'CR' in text:
            amount = Decimal(text.replace('CR', '').strip()) * 10000000
        elif 'L' in text:
            amount = Decimal(text.replace('L', '').strip()) * 100000
        else:
            amount = Decimal(text.replace(',', '').replace('₹', '').strip())
        
        if amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Amount must be positive")
        
        context.user_data['loan_amount'] = amount
        
        loan_type = context.user_data['loan_type']
        
        # Suggest tenure based on loan type
        tenure_suggestions = {
            'home': [180, 240, 300, 360],  # 15-30 years
            'personal': [12, 24, 36, 48, 60],  # 1-5 years
            'car': [36, 48, 60, 72, 84],  # 3-7 years
            'education': [60, 84, 120, 180]  # 5-15 years
        }
        
        suggestions = tenure_suggestions.get(loan_type, [12, 24, 36, 48, 60])
        
        keyboard = []
        row = []
        for tenure in suggestions:
            years = tenure // 12
            months = tenure % 12
            
            if months == 0:
                label = f"{years} years"
            else:
                label = f"{years}y {months}m"
            
            row.append(InlineKeyboardButton(label, callback_data=f"tenure_{tenure}"))
            
            if len(row) == 3:
                keyboard.append(row)
                row = []
        
        if row:
            keyboard.append(row)
        
        await update.message.reply_text(
            f"💰 Loan Amount: ₹{amount:,.0f}\n\n"

async def handle_quick_emi(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle quick EMI calculation"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    parts = query.data.replace("quick_emi_", "").split("_")
    amount = Decimal(parts[0])
    rate = Decimal(parts[1])
    
    calculator = LoanCalculator()
    
    message = f"📊 *EMI Calculation*\n"
    message += f"━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    message += f"💰 Loan Amount: ₹{amount:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"💹 Interest Rate: {rate}%\n\n"
    
    message += "*Monthly EMI by Tenure:*\n\n"
    
    tenures = [60, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360]  # 5-30 years
    
    for tenure in tenures:
        years = tenure // 12
        emi = calculator.calculate_emi(amount, rate, tenure)
        total_interest = calculator.calculate_total_interest(amount, emi, tenure)
        
        message += f"📅 *{years} years:* ₹{emi:,.0f}/month\n"
        message += f"   Total Interest: ₹{total_interest:,.0f}\n\n"
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📊 View Amortization", callback_data=f"amort_{amount}_{rate}_240")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔍 Compare Banks", callback_data="loan_type_home")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="loan_emi_calc")]
    ]
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def show_eligibility_check(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Start eligibility check flow"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    profile = get_user_loan_profile(user_id)
    
    if profile:
        # Show existing profile and allow update
        await show_eligibility_result(update, context, profile)
    else:
        # Start profile creation
        await query.edit_message_text(
            "✅ *Eligibility Check*\n\n"
            "Let's check your loan eligibility!\n\n"
            "Please enter your monthly income:\n"
            "_(Example: 75000 or 75K)_",
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        return PROFILE_INCOME

async def handle_income_input(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle income input for eligibility"""
    
    text = update.message.text.strip().upper()
    
    try:
        if 'K' in text:
            income = Decimal(text.replace('K', '').strip()) * 1000
        elif 'L' in text:
            income = Decimal(text.replace('L', '').strip()) * 100000
        else:
            income = Decimal(text.replace(',', '').replace('₹', '').strip())
        
        context.user_data['monthly_income'] = income
        
        await update.message.reply_text(
            f"✅ Monthly Income: ₹{income:,.0f}\n\n"
            "Enter your existing EMIs (0 if none):\n"
            "_(Total of all current loan EMIs)_"
        )
        
        return PROFILE_EMIS
        
    except:
        await update.message.reply_text(
            "❌ Invalid income. Please enter a number.\n"
            "Examples: 75000, 75K, 1.5L"
        )
        return PROFILE_INCOME

async def handle_emi_input(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle existing EMI input"""
    
    try:
        emis = Decimal(update.message.text.strip().replace(',', '').replace('₹', ''))
        context.user_data['existing_emis'] = emis
        
        await update.message.reply_text(
            f"✅ Existing EMIs: ₹{emis:,.0f}\n\n"
            "Enter your age:"
        )
        
        return PROFILE_AGE
        
    except:
        await update.message.reply_text("❌ Invalid amount. Please enter a number:")
        return PROFILE_EMIS

async def handle_age_input(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle age input and show eligibility"""
    
    try:
        age = int(update.message.text.strip())
        
        if age < 21 or age > 70:
            await update.message.reply_text("Age must be between 21 and 70.")
            return PROFILE_AGE
        
        # Create profile
        user_id = update.effective_user.id
        
        profile = UserLoanProfile(
            id=0,
            user_id=user_id,
            employment_type=EmploymentType.SALARIED,
            monthly_income=context.user_data['monthly_income'],
            existing_emis=context.user_data['existing_emis'],
            credit_score=None,
            age=age,
            city='',
            employer_category='Private',
            work_experience_years=5,
            created_at=datetime.now(),
            updated_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        save_user_loan_profile(profile)
        
        await show_eligibility_result(update, context, profile)
        return ConversationHandler.END
        
    except:
        await update.message.reply_text("❌ Invalid age. Please enter a number:")
        return PROFILE_AGE

async def show_eligibility_result(
    update: Update, 
    context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE,
    profile: UserLoanProfile
):
    """Show eligibility results"""
    
    calculator = LoanCalculator()
    
    message = "✅ *Your Loan Eligibility*\n"
    message += "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    message += f"💰 Monthly Income: ₹{profile.monthly_income:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"📊 Existing EMIs: ₹{profile.existing_emis:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"👤 Age: {profile.age} years\n\n"
    
    loan_types = [
        (LoanType.HOME, "🏠 Home Loan", 240),
        (LoanType.PERSONAL, "💳 Personal Loan", 60),
        (LoanType.CAR, "🚗 Car Loan", 60),
    ]
    
    message += "*Estimated Eligibility:*\n\n"
    
    for loan_type, name, default_tenure in loan_types:
        eligibility = calculator.calculate_eligibility(
            profile.monthly_income,
            profile.existing_emis,
            loan_type
        )
        
        if eligibility['eligible']:
            max_loan = calculator.estimate_max_loan(
                eligibility['max_emi'],
                Decimal('9'),  # Assume 9% rate
                default_tenure
            )
            
            message += f"{name}\n"
            message += f"├ Max EMI: ₹{eligibility['max_emi']:,.0f}\n"
            message += f"└ Max Loan: ₹{max_loan:,.0f}\n\n"
        else:
            message += f"{name}\n"
            message += f"└ ❌ {eligibility['reason']}\n\n"
    
    message += f"📊 Current FOIR: {eligibility['current_foir']:.1f}%\n"
    message += f"_(FOIR should be below {eligibility['max_foir']:.0f}%)_"
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔍 Find Matching Loans", callback_data="loan_type_home")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("✏️ Update Profile", callback_data="loan_update_profile")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="loan_menu")]
    ]
    
    if hasattr(update, 'callback_query') and update.callback_query:
        await update.callback_query.edit_message_text(
            message,
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
    else:
        await update.message.reply_text(
            message,
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
