# Idea #58: Household Budget Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

A family-focused budget management bot that helps households track income, expenses, savings goals, and manage shared finances with multiple family members.

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- No visibility into total household spending
- Difficulty coordinating finances between partners
- Overspending in specific categories
- Not saving enough for family goals
- Kids not learning money management
- Bill payment coordination chaos

## ⭐ Key Features

```
Phase 1 (Week 1-2):
├── Household setup
│   ├── Add family members
│   ├── Set income sources
│   └── Define budget categories
├── Expense tracking
│   ├── Quick add expenses
│   ├── Receipt photo capture
│   └── Category assignment
├── Budget limits per category
├── Spending alerts
├── Monthly overview
└── Bill reminders

Phase 2 (Week 3-4):
├── Savings goals (vacation, education)
├── Allowance management for kids
├── Expense approval workflow
├── Spending reports by member
├── Budget vs actual analysis
├── Financial insights
├── Export to spreadsheet
└── Multi-currency support
```

## 👨‍💻 Implementation

### Data Models

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, date
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum

class MemberRole(Enum):
    ADMIN = "admin"
    ADULT = "adult"
    TEEN = "teen"
    CHILD = "child"

class ExpenseStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    REJECTED = "rejected"

class GoalStatus(Enum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    PAUSED = "paused"

@dataclass
class Household:
    id: int
    name: str
    currency: str
    created_by: int
    monthly_income: Decimal
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class HouseholdMember:
    id: int
    household_id: int
    user_id: int
    name: str
    role: MemberRole
    monthly_allowance: Optional[Decimal]
    can_add_expenses: bool
    requires_approval: bool
    joined_at: datetime

@dataclass
class BudgetCategory:
    id: int
    household_id: int
    name: str
    icon: str
    monthly_limit: Decimal
    color: str
    is_essential: bool
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class Expense:
    id: int
    household_id: int
    member_id: int
    category_id: int
    amount: Decimal
    description: str
    date: date
    receipt_url: Optional[str]
    status: ExpenseStatus
    approved_by: Optional[int]
    notes: str
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class Income:
    id: int
    household_id: int
    member_id: int
    amount: Decimal
    source: str
    frequency: str  # monthly, weekly, one-time
    date: date
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class SavingsGoal:
    id: int
    household_id: int
    name: str
    target_amount: Decimal
    current_amount: Decimal
    target_date: Optional[date]
    status: GoalStatus
    icon: str
    contributors: List[int]  # Member IDs
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class SavingsContribution:
    id: int
    goal_id: int
    member_id: int
    amount: Decimal
    date: date
    notes: str

@dataclass
class Bill:
    id: int
    household_id: int
    name: str
    amount: Decimal
    due_day: int
    category_id: int
    is_auto_pay: bool
    reminder_days: int
    last_paid: Optional[date]
    created_at: datetime

@dataclass
class MonthlyBudgetSummary:
    household_id: int
    month: date
    total_income: Decimal
    total_expenses: Decimal
    total_savings: Decimal
    by_category: Dict[int, Dict]
    by_member: Dict[int, Decimal]
    budget_health: str  # good, warning, over
```

### Budget Management Engine

```python
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple
from calendar import monthrange

class HouseholdBudgetManager:
    """Manage household budget and finances"""
    
    def __init__(self, household_id: int):
        self.household_id = household_id
        self.household = get_household(household_id)
    
    def add_expense(
        self,
        member_id: int,
        category_id: int,
        amount: Decimal,
        description: str,
        expense_date: date = None,
        receipt_url: str = None
    ) -> Tuple[Expense, Optional[str]]:
        """Add a new expense"""
        
        if expense_date is None:
            expense_date = date.today()
        
        member = get_household_member(member_id)
        
        # Determine status based on member role
        if member.requires_approval:
            status = ExpenseStatus.PENDING
        else:
            status = ExpenseStatus.APPROVED
        
        expense = Expense(
            id=0,
            household_id=self.household_id,
            member_id=member_id,
            category_id=category_id,
            amount=amount,
            description=description,
            date=expense_date,
            receipt_url=receipt_url,
            status=status,
            approved_by=None if member.requires_approval else member_id,
            notes='',
            created_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        saved_expense = save_expense(expense)
        
        # Check budget alerts
        alert = self._check_category_budget(category_id, expense_date)
        
        return saved_expense, alert
    
    def _check_category_budget(self, category_id: int, expense_date: date) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check if category budget is exceeded"""
        
        category = get_budget_category(category_id)
        
        # Get month's expenses for this category
        month_start = expense_date.replace(day=1)
        month_end = expense_date.replace(day=monthrange(expense_date.year, expense_date.month)[1])
        
        total_spent = get_category_spending(
            self.household_id,
            category_id,
            month_start,
            month_end
        )
        
        percentage = (total_spent / category.monthly_limit * 100) if category.monthly_limit > 0 else 0
        
        if percentage >= 100:
            return f"⚠️ {category.name} budget exceeded! ({percentage:.0f}%)"
        elif percentage >= 80:
            return f"⚡ {category.name} budget at {percentage:.0f}%"
        
        return None
    
    def get_monthly_summary(self, month: date = None) -> MonthlyBudgetSummary:
        """Get monthly budget summary"""
        
        if month is None:
            month = date.today().replace(day=1)
        
        month_start = month.replace(day=1)
        month_end = month.replace(day=monthrange(month.year, month.month)[1])
        
        # Get all expenses for the month
        expenses = get_household_expenses(
            self.household_id,
            month_start,
            month_end,
            status=ExpenseStatus.APPROVED
        )
        
        # Get income for the month
        incomes = get_household_income(self.household_id, month_start, month_end)
        
        total_income = sum(i.amount for i in incomes)
        total_expenses = sum(e.amount for e in expenses)
        
        # Savings contributions
        contributions = get_savings_contributions(self.household_id, month_start, month_end)
        total_savings = sum(c.amount for c in contributions)
        
        # By category
        categories = get_household_categories(self.household_id)
        by_category = {}
        
        for cat in categories:
            cat_expenses = [e for e in expenses if e.category_id == cat.id]
            cat_total = sum(e.amount for e in cat_expenses)
            
            by_category[cat.id] = {
                'name': cat.name,
                'icon': cat.icon,
                'spent': float(cat_total),
                'budget': float(cat.monthly_limit),
                'percentage': float(cat_total / cat.monthly_limit * 100) if cat.monthly_limit > 0 else 0,
                'remaining': float(cat.monthly_limit - cat_total)
            }
        
        # By member
        members = get_household_members(self.household_id)
        by_member = {}
        
        for member in members:
            member_expenses = [e for e in expenses if e.member_id == member.id]
            by_member[member.id] = {
                'name': member.name,
                'spent': float(sum(e.amount for e in member_expenses)),
                'expense_count': len(member_expenses)
            }
        
        # Budget health
        if total_expenses <= total_income * Decimal('0.8'):
            budget_health = 'good'
        elif total_expenses <= total_income:
            budget_health = 'warning'
        else:
            budget_health = 'over'
        
        return MonthlyBudgetSummary(
            household_id=self.household_id,
            month=month,
            total_income=total_income,
            total_expenses=total_expenses,
            total_savings=total_savings,
            by_category=by_category,
            by_member=by_member,
            budget_health=budget_health
        )
    
    def approve_expense(self, expense_id: int, approver_id: int) -> bool:
        """Approve a pending expense"""
        
        expense = get_expense(expense_id)
        approver = get_household_member_by_user(self.household_id, approver_id)
        
        if not approver or approver.role not in [MemberRole.ADMIN, MemberRole.ADULT]:
            return False
        
        expense.status = ExpenseStatus.APPROVED
        expense.approved_by = approver.id
        update_expense(expense)
        
        return True
    
    def reject_expense(self, expense_id: int, approver_id: int, reason: str = '') -> bool:
        """Reject a pending expense"""
        
        expense = get_expense(expense_id)
        approver = get_household_member_by_user(self.household_id, approver_id)
        
        if not approver or approver.role not in [MemberRole.ADMIN, MemberRole.ADULT]:
            return False
        
        expense.status = ExpenseStatus.REJECTED
        expense.notes = reason
        update_expense(expense)
        
        return True
    
    def create_savings_goal(
        self,
        name: str,
        target_amount: Decimal,
        target_date: date = None,
        icon: str = '🎯'
    ) -> SavingsGoal:
        """Create a new savings goal"""
        
        goal = SavingsGoal(
            id=0,
            household_id=self.household_id,
            name=name,
            target_amount=target_amount,
            current_amount=Decimal(0),
            target_date=target_date,
            status=GoalStatus.ACTIVE,
            icon=icon,
            contributors=[],
            created_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        return save_savings_goal(goal)
    
    def contribute_to_goal(
        self,
        goal_id: int,
        member_id: int,
        amount: Decimal,
        notes: str = ''
    ) -> Tuple[SavingsContribution, bool]:
        """Add contribution to a savings goal"""
        
        goal = get_savings_goal(goal_id)
        
        contribution = SavingsContribution(
            id=0,
            goal_id=goal_id,
            member_id=member_id,
            amount=amount,
            date=date.today(),
            notes=notes
        )
        
        saved = save_savings_contribution(contribution)
        
        # Update goal
        goal.current_amount += amount
        if member_id not in goal.contributors:
            goal.contributors.append(member_id)
        
        goal_completed = goal.current_amount >= goal.target_amount
        if goal_completed:
            goal.status = GoalStatus.COMPLETED
        
        update_savings_goal(goal)
        
        return saved, goal_completed
    
    def get_spending_insights(self, months: int = 3) -> Dict:
        """Get spending insights and recommendations"""
        
        insights = []
        
        # Get data for analysis
        summaries = []
        for i in range(months):
            month = date.today().replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=30*i)
            summaries.append(self.get_monthly_summary(month))
        
        current = summaries[0]
        
        # Overspending categories
        for cat_id, cat_data in current.by_category.items():
            if cat_data['percentage'] > 100:
                insights.append({
                    'type': 'warning',
                    'category': cat_data['name'],
                    'message': f"{cat_data['name']} is {cat_data['percentage']:.0f}% of budget",
                    'suggestion': f"Try to reduce by ${cat_data['spent'] - cat_data['budget']:.0f}"
                })
        
        # Spending trends
        if len(summaries) >= 2:
            prev = summaries[1]
            change = float(current.total_expenses - prev.total_expenses)
            change_pct = change / float(prev.total_expenses) * 100 if prev.total_expenses > 0 else 0
            
            if change_pct > 20:
                insights.append({
                    'type': 'trend',
                    'message': f"Spending increased {change_pct:.0f}% vs last month",
                    'suggestion': "Review recent expenses for unnecessary spending"
                })
            elif change_pct < -10:
                insights.append({
                    'type': 'positive',
                    'message': f"Great! Spending decreased {abs(change_pct):.0f}% vs last month",
                    'suggestion': "Keep up the good work!"
                })
        
        # Savings rate
        if current.total_income > 0:
            savings_rate = float((current.total_income - current.total_expenses) / current.total_income * 100)
            
            if savings_rate < 10:
                insights.append({
                    'type': 'warning',
                    'message': f"Savings rate is only {savings_rate:.0f}%",
                    'suggestion': "Aim for at least 20% savings rate"
                })
            elif savings_rate >= 30:
                insights.append({
                    'type': 'positive',
                    'message': f"Excellent savings rate of {savings_rate:.0f}%!",
                    'suggestion': None
                })
        
        return {
            'insights': insights,
            'current_month': {
                'income': float(current.total_income),
                'expenses': float(current.total_expenses),
                'savings': float(current.total_savings),
                'health': current.budget_health
            }
        }


class AllowanceManager:
    """Manage allowances for kids/teens"""
    
    def __init__(self, household_id: int):
        self.household_id = household_id
    
    def get_member_balance(self, member_id: int) -> Dict:
        """Get allowance balance for a member"""
        
        member = get_household_member(member_id)
        
        if member.monthly_allowance is None:
            return {'has_allowance': False}
        
        # Calculate available balance
        month_start = date.today().replace(day=1)
        
        # Get expenses by this member
        expenses = get_member_expenses(member_id, month_start, date.today())
        total_spent = sum(e.amount for e in expenses if e.status == ExpenseStatus.APPROVED)
        
        available = member.monthly_allowance - total_spent
        
        return {
            'has_allowance': True,
            'monthly_allowance': float(member.monthly_allowance),
            'spent_this_month': float(total_spent),
            'available': float(available),
            'percentage_used': float(total_spent / member.monthly_allowance * 100) if member.monthly_allowance > 0 else 0
        }
    
    def set_allowance(self, member_id: int, amount: Decimal) -> bool:
        """Set monthly allowance for a member"""
        
        member = get_household_member(member_id)
        member.monthly_allowance = amount
        member.requires_approval = True  # Allowance members need approval
        
        update_household_member(member)
        return True
```

### Telegram Bot Handlers

```python
from telegram import Update, InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes, ConversationHandler

# States
ADD_EXPENSE_AMOUNT, ADD_EXPENSE_CATEGORY, ADD_EXPENSE_DESCRIPTION = range(3)
SETUP_HOUSEHOLD_NAME, SETUP_INCOME, SETUP_CATEGORIES = range(3, 6)

async def cmd_budget(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Main budget command"""
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    
    if not household:
        keyboard = [[InlineKeyboardButton("🏠 Create Household", callback_data="budget_create")]]
        await update.message.reply_text(
            "👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 *Household Budget*\n\n"
            "Welcome! Let's set up your household budget.",
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        return
    
    manager = HouseholdBudgetManager(household.id)
    summary = manager.get_monthly_summary()
    
    health_emoji = {
        'good': '🟢',
        'warning': '🟡',
        'over': '🔴'
    }
    
    remaining = summary.total_income - summary.total_expenses
    
    message = f"👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 *{household.name}*\n"
    message += f"_{date.today().strftime('%B %Y')}_\n"
    message += "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    message += f"{health_emoji.get(summary.budget_health, '⚪')} *Budget Status*\n\n"
    message += f"💰 Income: {household.currency} {summary.total_income:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"💸 Expenses: {household.currency} {summary.total_expenses:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"💵 Remaining: {household.currency} {remaining:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"🎯 Savings: {household.currency} {summary.total_savings:,.0f}\n\n"
    
    # Top spending categories
    sorted_cats = sorted(summary.by_category.values(), key=lambda x: -x['spent'])[:3]
    
    if sorted_cats:
        message += "*Top Categories:*\n"
        for cat in sorted_cats:
            pct_bar = "█" * int(cat['percentage'] / 10) + "░" * (10 - int(cat['percentage'] / 10))
            message += f"{cat['icon']} {cat['name']}: {cat['percentage']:.0f}%\n"
            message += f"   {pct_bar}\n"
    
    keyboard = [
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("➕ Add Expense", callback_data="budget_add_expense"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("📊 Categories", callback_data="budget_categories")
        ],
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("👥 Members", callback_data="budget_members"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("🎯 Goals", callback_data="budget_goals")
        ],
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("📋 Expenses", callback_data="budget_expenses"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("💡 Insights", callback_data="budget_insights")
        ],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("⚙️ Settings", callback_data="budget_settings")]
    ]
    
    # Check for pending approvals
    pending = get_pending_expenses(household.id)
    if pending:
        keyboard.insert(0, [
            InlineKeyboardButton(f"⏳ Pending Approvals ({len(pending)})", callback_data="budget_pending")
        ])
    
    await update.message.reply_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def start_add_expense(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Start adding an expense"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    
    context.user_data['expense_household'] = household.id
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        "➕ *Add Expense*\n\n"
        f"Enter the amount ({household.currency}):",
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )
    
    return ADD_EXPENSE_AMOUNT

async def handle_expense_amount(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle expense amount input"""
    
    try:
        amount = Decimal(update.message.text.strip().replace(',', ''))
        
        if amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Amount must be positive")
        
        context.user_data['expense_amount'] = amount
        
        household_id = context.user_data['expense_household']
        categories = get_household_categories(household_id)
        
        keyboard = []
        row = []
        for cat in categories:
            row.append(InlineKeyboardButton(
                f"{cat.icon} {cat.name}",
                callback_data=f"expcat_{cat.id}"
            ))
            if len(row) == 2:
                keyboard.append(row)
                row = []
        if row:
            keyboard.append(row)
        
        await update.message.reply_text(
            f"💰 Amount: {amount:,.2f}\n\n"
            "Select category:",
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
            parse_mode='Markdown'
        )
        
        return ADD_EXPENSE_CATEGORY
        
    except (ValueError, InvalidOperation):
        await update.message.reply_text("❌ Invalid amount. Please enter a number:")
        return ADD_EXPENSE_AMOUNT

async def handle_expense_category(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle expense category selection"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    category_id = int(query.data.replace("expcat_", ""))
    context.user_data['expense_category'] = category_id
    
    category = get_budget_category(category_id)
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        f"💰 Amount: {context.user_data['expense_amount']:,.2f}\n"
        f"{category.icon} Category: {category.name}\n\n"
        "Enter a description (or /skip):",
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )
    
    return ADD_EXPENSE_DESCRIPTION

async def handle_expense_description(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle expense description and save"""
    
    description = update.message.text.strip()
    
    if description == '/skip':
        description = ''
    
    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    household_id = context.user_data['expense_household']
    
    member = get_household_member_by_user(household_id, user_id)
    manager = HouseholdBudgetManager(household_id)
    
    expense, alert = manager.add_expense(
        member_id=member.id,
        category_id=context.user_data['expense_category'],
        amount=context.user_data['expense_amount'],
        description=description
    )
    
    category = get_budget_category(expense.category_id)
    household = get_household(household_id)
    
    status_text = "✅ Approved" if expense.status == ExpenseStatus.APPROVED else "⏳ Pending Approval"
    
    message = f"✅ *Expense Added*\n\n"
    message += f"💰 {household.currency} {expense.amount:,.2f}\n"
    message += f"{category.icon} {category.name}\n"
    message += f"📝 {description or 'No description'}\n"
    message += f"📋 Status: {status_text}\n"
    
    if alert:
        message += f"\n{alert}"
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("➕ Add Another", callback_data="budget_add_expense")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("📊 View Budget", callback_data="budget_menu")]
    ]
    
    await update.message.reply_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )
    
    # Clear context
    for key in ['expense_household', 'expense_amount', 'expense_category']:
        context.user_data.pop(key, None)
    
    # Notify admins if pending
    if expense.status == ExpenseStatus.PENDING:
        await notify_admins_pending_expense(household_id, expense, member)
    
    return ConversationHandler.END

async def show_categories(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show category breakdown"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    
    manager = HouseholdBudgetManager(household.id)
    summary = manager.get_monthly_summary()
    
    message = f"📊 *Category Breakdown*\n"
    message += f"_{date.today().strftime('%B %Y')}_\n"
    message += "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    sorted_cats = sorted(summary.by_category.values(), key=lambda x: -x['spent'])
    
    for cat in sorted_cats:
        status_emoji = "🟢" if cat['percentage'] < 80 else "🟡" if cat['percentage'] < 100 else "🔴"
        
        message += f"{cat['icon']} *{cat['name']}*\n"
        message += f"   {status_emoji} {household.currency} {cat['spent']:,.0f} / {cat['budget']:,.0f}\n"
        
        # Progress bar
        filled = min(int(cat['percentage'] / 10), 10)
        bar = "█" * filled + "░" * (10 - filled)
        message += f"   {bar} {cat['percentage']:.0f}%\n\n"
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("✏️ Edit Budgets", callback_data="budget_edit_cats")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="budget_menu")]
    ]
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def show_savings_goals(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show savings goals"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    
    goals = get_household_savings_goals(household.id)
    
    message = "🎯 *Savings Goals*\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    if not goals:
        message += "No savings goals yet.\nCreate one to start saving together!\n"
    else:
        for goal in goals:
            progress = float(goal.current_amount / goal.target_amount * 100) if goal.target_amount > 0 else 0
            filled = min(int(progress / 10), 10)
            bar = "█" * filled + "░" * (10 - filled)
            
            status = "✅" if goal.status == GoalStatus.COMPLETED else "🎯"
            
            message += f"{status} *{goal.icon} {goal.name}*\n"
            message += f"   {household.currency} {goal.current_amount:,.0f} / {goal.target_amount:,.0f}\n"
            message += f"   {bar} {progress:.0f}%\n"
            
            if goal.target_date and goal.status == GoalStatus.ACTIVE:
                days_left = (goal.target_date - date.today()).days
                if days_left > 0:
                    message += f"   📅 {days_left} days left\n"
            
            message += "\n"
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("➕ New Goal", callback_data="budget_new_goal")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("💰 Contribute", callback_data="budget_contribute")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="budget_menu")]
    ]
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def show_pending_approvals(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show pending expense approvals"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    member = get_household_member_by_user(household.id, user_id)
    
    # Check if user can approve
    if member.role not in [MemberRole.ADMIN, MemberRole.ADULT]:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            "❌ You don't have permission to approve expenses."
        )
        return
    
    pending = get_pending_expenses(household.id)
    
    if not pending:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            "✅ No pending expenses to approve!",
            reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup([
                [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="budget_menu")]
            ])
        )
        return
    
    message = "⏳ *Pending Approvals*\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    keyboard = []
    
    for expense in pending[:5]:
        expense_member = get_household_member(expense.member_id)
        category = get_budget_category(expense.category_id)
        
        message += f"*{expense_member.name}*\n"
        message += f"{category.icon} {category.name}\n"
        message += f"💰 {household.currency} {expense.amount:,.2f}\n"
        message += f"📝 {expense.description or 'No description'}\n"
        message += f"📅 {expense.date.strftime('%b %d')}\n\n"
        
        keyboard.append([
            InlineKeyboardButton(f"✅ Approve", callback_data=f"approve_{expense.id}"),
            InlineKeyboardButton(f"❌ Reject", callback_data=f"reject_{expense.id}")
        ])
    
    keyboard.append([InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="budget_menu")])
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def handle_expense_approval(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle expense approval/rejection"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    
    action = query.data.split('_')[0]
    expense_id = int(query.data.split('_')[1])
    
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    
    manager = HouseholdBudgetManager(household.id)
    
    if action == 'approve':
        success = manager.approve_expense(expense_id, user_id)
        if success:
            await query.answer("✅ Expense approved!")
        else:
            await query.answer("❌ Could not approve expense")
    else:
        success = manager.reject_expense(expense_id, user_id)
        if success:
            await query.answer("❌ Expense rejected")
    
    # Refresh the list
    await show_pending_approvals(update, context)

async def show_insights(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show budget insights"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer("Analyzing...")
    
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    
    manager = HouseholdBudgetManager(household.id)
    insights_data = manager.get_spending_insights(months=3)
    
    message = "💡 *Budget Insights*\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    current = insights_data['current_month']
    
    message += f"*This Month:*\n"
    message += f"💰 Income: {household.currency} {current['income']:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"💸 Expenses: {household.currency} {current['expenses']:,.0f}\n"
    message += f"📊 Status: {current['health'].title()}\n\n"
    
    if insights_data['insights']:
        message += "*Recommendations:*\n\n"
        
        for insight in insights_data['insights']:
            type_emoji = {
                'warning': '⚠️',
                'trend': '📈',
                'positive': '✅'
            }
            
            emoji = type_emoji.get(insight['type'], '💡')
            message += f"{emoji} {insight['message']}\n"
            if insight.get('suggestion'):
                message += f"   _{insight['suggestion']}_\n"
            message += "\n"
    else:
        message += "✅ Your budget looks healthy! Keep it up!\n"
    
    keyboard = [[InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="budget_menu")]]
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

async def show_member_management(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Show household members"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    await query.answer()
    
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    household = get_user_household(user_id)
    
    members = get_household_members(household.id)
    
    manager = HouseholdBudgetManager(household.id)
    summary = manager.get_monthly_summary()
    
    message = "👥 *Household Members*\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n"
    
    role_emoji = {
        MemberRole.ADMIN: '👑',
        MemberRole.ADULT: '👤',
        MemberRole.TEEN: '🧑',
        MemberRole.CHILD: '👶'
    }
    
    for member in members:
        emoji = role_emoji.get(member.role, '👤')
        member_data = summary.by_member.get(member.id, {'spent': 0, 'expense_count': 0})
        
        message += f"{emoji} *{member.name}* ({member.role.value.title()})\n"
        message += f"   💸 Spent: {household.currency} {member_data['spent']:,.0f}\n"
        
        if member.monthly_allowance:
            allowance_mgr = AllowanceManager(household.id)
            balance = allowance_mgr.get_member_balance(member.id)
            message += f"   💵 Allowance: {household.currency} {balance['available']:,.0f} left\n"
        
        message += "\n"
    
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton("➕ Add Member", callback_data="budget_add_member")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("💵 Set Allowances", callback_data="budget_allowances")],
        [InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Back", callback_data="budget_menu")]
    ]
    
    await query.edit_message_text(
        message,
        reply_markup=InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard),
        parse_mode='Markdown'
    )

# Idea #59: NFT and Metaverse Education Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

An interactive educational bot that teaches users about NFTs, blockchain technology, metaverse platforms, digital art creation, and Web3 concepts through structured lessons, quizzes, simulations, and hands-on projects.

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- Confusing NFT and blockchain terminology
- Scams and rug pulls due to lack of knowledge
- Not understanding how to create, buy, or sell NFTs
- Missing opportunities in the metaverse economy
- No practical guidance for entering Web3
- Overwhelming amount of misinformation
- Fear of losing money due to inexperience

## ⭐ Key Features

```
Phase 1 (Week 1-3):
├── Structured curriculum
│   ├── Blockchain basics
│   ├── NFT fundamentals
│   ├── Wallet setup guide
│   ├── Marketplace navigation
│   └── Digital art basics
├── Interactive glossary
├── Quizzes with rewards
├── Scam detection training
├── Daily Web3 news digest
├── Project evaluation tools
└── Community discussions

Phase 2 (Week 4-5):
├── NFT creation workshop
├── Metaverse platform guides
├── Portfolio tracker
├── Price alerts for collections
├── Rarity analysis tools
├── Creator verification
├── Investment simulator
└── Certificate generation
```

## 👨‍💻 Complete Implementation

### Data Models

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, date
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum

class ContentCategory(Enum):
    BLOCKCHAIN_BASICS = "blockchain_basics"
    NFT_FUNDAMENTALS = "nft_fundamentals"
    WALLETS_SECURITY = "wallets_security"
    MARKETPLACES = "marketplaces"
    CREATING_NFTS = "creating_nfts"
    METAVERSE = "metaverse"
    DEFI_BASICS = "defi_basics"
    LEGAL_TAX = "legal_tax"
    SCAM_PREVENTION = "scam_prevention"
    ADVANCED_TRADING = "advanced_trading"

class DifficultyLevel(Enum):
    BEGINNER = "beginner"
    INTERMEDIATE = "intermediate"
    ADVANCED = "advanced"

class ContentType(Enum):
    LESSON = "lesson"
    QUIZ = "quiz"
    TUTORIAL = "tutorial"
    SIMULATION = "simulation"
    PROJECT = "project"

class BlockchainNetwork(Enum):
    ETHEREUM = "ethereum"
    POLYGON = "polygon"
    SOLANA = "solana"
    BITCOIN = "bitcoin"
    BINANCE = "binance"
    AVALANCHE = "avalanche"
    TEZOS = "tezos"

class NFTCategory(Enum):
    ART = "art"

    MUSIC = "music"
    VIRTUAL_LAND = "virtual_land"
    DOMAIN_NAMES = "domain_names"
    PHOTOGRAPHY = "photography"
    UTILITY = "utility"

@dataclass
class Course:

### Education Engine

```python
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
import random

class NFTEducationEngine:
    """Core education engine for NFT and Web3 learning"""
    
    def __init__(self, user_id: int):
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.progress = self._get_or_create_progress()
    
    def _get_or_create_progress(self) -> UserProgress:
        """Get or create user progress"""
        
        progress = get_user_progress(self.user_id)
        
        if not progress:
            progress = UserProgress(
                id=0,
                user_id=self.user_id,
                total_points=0,
                courses_completed=[],
                lessons_completed=[],
                quizzes_passed=[],
                current_streak=0,
                longest_streak=0,
                rank="Newcomer",
                badges=[],
                certificates=[],
                last_activity=datetime.now(),
                created_at=datetime.now()
            )
            progress = save_user_progress(progress)
        
        return progress
    
    def get_recommended_course(self) -> Optional[Course]:
        """Get recommended next course based on progress"""
        
        all_courses = get_all_courses()
        
        # Filter out completed courses
        available = [c for c in all_courses if c.id not in self.progress.courses_completed]
        
        # Sort by difficulty and prerequisites
        def course_score(course):
            # Check prerequisites
            prereqs_met = all(p in self.progress.courses_completed for p in course.prerequisites)
            
            if not prereqs_met:
                return 1000  # Push to end
            
            difficulty_order = {
                DifficultyLevel.BEGINNER: 0,
                DifficultyLevel.INTERMEDIATE: 1,
                DifficultyLevel.ADVANCED: 2
            }
            
            return difficulty_order.get(course.difficulty, 0)
        
        available.sort(key=course_score)
        
        return available[0] if available else None
    
    def get_learning_path(self) -> List[Dict]:
        """Generate personalized learning path"""
        
        paths = {
            'collector': [
                ContentCategory.BLOCKCHAIN_BASICS,
                ContentCategory.NFT_FUNDAMENTALS,
                ContentCategory.WALLETS_SECURITY,
                ContentCategory.MARKETPLACES,
                ContentCategory.SCAM_PREVENTION,
                ContentCategory.ADVANCED_TRADING
            ],
            'creator': [
                ContentCategory.BLOCKCHAIN_BASICS,
                ContentCategory.NFT_FUNDAMENTALS,
                ContentCategory.CREATING_NFTS,
                ContentCategory.MARKETPLACES,
                ContentCategory.LEGAL_TAX
            ],
            'explorer': [
                ContentCategory.BLOCKCHAIN_BASICS,
                ContentCategory.METAVERSE,
                ContentCategory.WALLETS_SECURITY,
                ContentCategory.NFT_FUNDAMENTALS
            ]
        }
        
        # Default to collector path
        selected_path = paths['collector']
        
        path_courses = []
        
        for category in selected_path:
            courses = get_courses_by_category(category)
            
            for course in courses:
                is_completed = course.id in self.progress.courses_completed
                is_in_progress = any(
                    l.course_id == course.id 
                    for l in get_course_lessons(course.id) 
                    if l.id in self.progress.lessons_completed
                ) and not is_completed
                
                path_courses.append({
                    'course': course,
                    'status': 'completed' if is_completed else 'in_progress' if is_in_progress else 'locked',
                    'progress': self._get_course_progress(course.id)
                })
        
        return path_courses
    
    def _get_course_progress(self, course_id: int) -> float:
        """Get completion percentage for a course"""
        
        lessons = get_course_lessons(course_id)
        
        if not lessons:
            return 0
        
        completed = sum(1 for l in lessons if l.id in self.progress.lessons_completed)
        
        return completed / len(lessons) * 100
    
    def complete_lesson(self, lesson_id: int) -> Dict:
        """Mark lesson as completed"""
        
        lesson = get_lesson(lesson_id)
        
        if lesson_id in self.progress.lessons_completed:
            return {'already_completed': True, 'points': 0}
        
        # Add to completed
        self.progress.lessons_completed.append(lesson_id)
        self.progress.total_points += lesson.points
        
        # Update streak
        self._update_streak()
        
        # Check for course completion
        course_completed = self._check_course_completion(lesson.course_id)
        
        # Check for new badges
        new_badges = self._check_badges()
        
        # Update rank
        self._update_rank()
        
        save_user_progress(self.progress)
        
        return {
            'points_earned': lesson.points,
            'total_points': self.progress.total_points,
            'course_completed': course_completed,
            'new_badges': new_badges,
            'rank': self.progress.rank,
            'streak': self.progress.current_streak
        }
    
    def _update_streak(self):
        """Update learning streak"""
        
        today = date.today()
        last_active = self.progress.last_activity.date()
        
        if last_active == today:
            return
        elif last_active == today - timedelta(days=1):
            self.progress.current_streak += 1
        else:
            self.progress.current_streak = 1
        
        if self.progress.current_streak > self.progress.longest_streak:
            self.progress.longest_streak = self.progress.current_streak
        
        self.progress.last_activity = datetime.now()
    
    def _check_course_completion(self, course_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if course is now completed"""
        
        if course_id in self.progress.courses_completed:
            return False
        
        lessons = get_course_lessons(course_id)
        all_completed = all(l.id in self.progress.lessons_completed for l in lessons)
        
        if all_completed:
            self.progress.courses_completed.append(course_id)
            
            # Award bonus points
            course = get_course(course_id)
            self.progress.total_points += course.rewards_points
            
            # Generate certificate
            self._generate_certificate(course)
            
            return True
        
        return False
    
    def _check_badges(self) -> List[str]:
        """Check and award new badges"""
        
        new_badges = []
        
        badge_criteria = {
            'first_lesson': lambda p: len(p.lessons_completed) >= 1,
            'five_lessons': lambda p: len(p.lessons_completed) >= 5,
            'course_graduate': lambda p: len(p.courses_completed) >= 1,
            'three_courses': lambda p: len(p.courses_completed) >= 3,
            'week_streak': lambda p: p.current_streak >= 7,
            'month_streak': lambda p: p.current_streak >= 30,
            'quiz_master': lambda p: len(p.quizzes_passed) >= 10,
            'point_collector_100': lambda p: p.total_points >= 100,
            'point_collector_500': lambda p: p.total_points >= 500,
            'point_collector_1000': lambda p: p.total_points >= 1000,
        }
        
        for badge, criteria in badge_criteria.items():
            if badge not in self.progress.badges and criteria(self.progress):
                self.progress.badges.append(badge)
                new_badges.append(badge)
        
        return new_badges
    
    def _update_rank(self):
        """Update user rank based on points"""
        
        ranks = [
            (0, "Newcomer"),
            (100, "Explorer"),
            (300, "Collector"),
            (600, "Enthusiast"),
            (1000, "Expert"),
            (2000, "Veteran"),
            (5000, "Master"),
            (10000, "Legend")
        ]
        
        for threshold, rank in reversed(ranks):
            if self.progress.total_points >= threshold:
                self.progress.rank = rank
                break
    
    def _generate_certificate(self, course: Course):
        """Generate completion certificate"""
        
        certificate = {
            'course_id': course.id,
            'course_title': course.title,
            'completed_at': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'certificate_id': f"CERT-{self.user_id}-{course.id}-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}"
        }
        
        self.progress.certificates.append(certificate)
    
    def submit_quiz(self, quiz_id: int, answers: List[int]) -> Dict:
        """Submit quiz answers"""
        
        quiz = get_quiz(quiz_id)
        
        correct = 0
        total_points = 0
        results = []
        
        for i, (answer, question) in enumerate(zip(answers, quiz.questions)):
            is_correct = answer == question['correct']
            
            if is_correct:
                correct += 1
                total_points += question.get('points', 10)
            
            results.append({
                'question': question['question'],
                'your_answer': question['options'][answer] if answer < len(question['options']) else 'No answer',
                'correct_answer': question['options'][question['correct']],
                'is_correct': is_correct,
                'explanation': question.get('explanation', '')
            })
        
        score = int(correct / len(quiz.questions) * 100)
        passed = score >= quiz.passing_score
        
        if passed and quiz_id not in self.progress.quizzes_passed:
            self.progress.quizzes_passed.append(quiz_id)
            self.progress.total_points += total_points
            save_user_progress(self.progress)
        
        return {
            'score': score,
            'passed': passed,
            'correct': correct,
            'total': len(quiz.questions),
            'points_earned': total_points if passed else 0,
            'results': results
        }


class ScamDetectionTrainer:
    """Train users to identify NFT scams"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.patterns = self._load_scam_patterns()
    
    def _load_scam_patterns(self) -> List[ScamPattern]:
        """Load scam patterns database"""
        
        return [
            ScamPattern(
                id=1,
                name="Rug Pull",
                description="Creators abandon project after collecting funds",
                red_flags=[
                    "Anonymous team with no verifiable identity",
                    "No clear roadmap or whitepaper",
                    "Unrealistic promises of returns",
                    "Pressure to buy quickly",
                    "Locked liquidity for short periods only"
                ],
                examples=[
                    "Team wallets holding large % of supply",
                    "Sudden removal of liquidity"
                ],
                prevention_tips=[
                    "Research team backgrounds",
                    "Check contract for owner privileges",
                    "Look for audited smart contracts",
                    "Verify community engagement authenticity"
                ],
                severity="critical"
            ),
            ScamPattern(
                id=2,
                name="Phishing",
                description="Fake websites or messages stealing wallet credentials",
                red_flags=[
                    "Unsolicited DMs asking to connect wallet",
                    "URLs slightly different from official sites",
                    "Requests for seed phrase or private keys",
                    "Too-good-to-be-true airdrops",
                    "Fake customer support accounts"
                ],
                examples=[
                    "opensea.io vs 0pensea.io",
                    "DM claiming you won a free NFT"
                ],
                prevention_tips=[
                    "Never share seed phrase",
                    "Bookmark official sites",
                    "Verify URLs carefully",
                    "Official support never DMs first"
                ],
                severity="critical"
            ),
            ScamPattern(
                id=3,
                name="Wash Trading",
                description="Artificially inflating prices through fake trades",
                red_flags=[
                    "Sudden price spikes without news",
                    "Same wallets trading back and forth",
                    "Volume doesn't match holder count",
                    "Price drops immediately after spikes"
                ],
                examples=[
                    "NFT sold 10 times in one day between 3 wallets",
                    "Floor price 10x in hours"
                ],
                prevention_tips=[
                    "Check transaction history on blockchain explorer",
                    "Look for organic trading patterns",
                    "Research buyer wallet histories"
                ],
                severity="high"
            ),
            ScamPattern(
                id=4,
                name="Fake Collection",
                description="Counterfeit versions of popular NFT collections",
                red_flags=[
                    "Collection name slightly misspelled",
                    "Not verified on marketplace",
                    "Much lower prices than original",
                    "Different contract address",
                    "Low holder count"
                ],
                examples=[
                    "Bored Ape Yatch Club (misspelled)",
                    "BAYC with different contract"
                ],
                prevention_tips=[
                    "Always check verified badge",
                    "Verify contract address on official channels",
                    "Compare with official collection stats"
                ],
                severity="high"
            ),
            ScamPattern(
                id=5,
                name="Pump and Dump",
                description="Coordinated buying to inflate price then selling",
                red_flags=[
                    "Aggressive social media promotion",
                    "Celebrity endorsements without disclosure",
                    "Rapid price increase",
                    "FOMO-inducing messaging",
                    "No real utility or roadmap"
                ],
                examples=[
                    "Influencer promotes then sells at peak",
                    "Telegram groups coordinating buys"
                ],
                prevention_tips=[
                    "Be skeptical of hype",
                    "Research before influencer recommendations",
                    "Check if promoters are paid"
                ],
                severity="high"
            )
        ]
    
    def get_training_scenario(self, difficulty: DifficultyLevel = None) -> Dict:
        """Generate a scam detection training scenario"""
        
        pattern = random.choice(self.patterns)
        
        # Generate a fake project scenario
        scenario = self._generate_scenario(pattern)
        
        return {
            'scenario': scenario,
            'red_flags_present': random.sample(pattern.red_flags, min(3, len(pattern.red_flags))),
            'correct_answer': pattern.name,
            'explanation': pattern.description,
            'prevention_tips': pattern.prevention_tips
        }
    
    def _generate_scenario(self, pattern: ScamPattern) -> str:
        """Generate realistic scam scenario"""
        
        scenarios = {
            "Rug Pull": """
🎨 *Project: CryptoKittenz Genesis*

You discover a new NFT project:
• Mint price: 0.08 ETH
• Total supply: 10,000
• Team: Anonymous "experienced devs"
• Discord: 50,000 members (joined in 2 days)
• Roadmap: Metaverse game, token launch, merch

The founder says: "We're going to 100x easily! 
This is the next BAYC. Mint closes in 2 hours!"

No LinkedIn or doxxed team members.
Contract not audited.
""",
            "Phishing": """
📨 *Received DM on Discord*

From: OpenSea_Support#1234

"Congratulations! Your wallet has been selected 
for an exclusive airdrop of 5 ETH worth of NFTs!

To claim, connect your wallet at:
opensea-claims.com/airdrop

Act fast - offer expires in 1 hour!

If you have any issues, send us your wallet 
seed phrase and we'll add them manually."
""",
            "Wash Trading": """
📈 *Project: PixelPunks Official*

You're researching a collection:
• Floor was 0.1 ETH yesterday
• Now floor is 1.2 ETH (1,100% increase)
• 24h volume: 500 ETH
• Total holders: 127

Looking at recent sales:
• Same 3 wallets bought 80% of volume
• All trades happened within 4 hours
• Wallets were created this week
""",
            "Fake Collection": """
🖼️ *Marketplace Listing*

You find what looks like a great deal:

"Board Ape Yacht Club #4521"
Price: 2.5 ETH (Real floor: 80 ETH)

• Collection: Board Ape Yatch Club
• No verified checkmark
• 234 items in collection
• 89 owners
• Contract: 0x1234...different from official
""",
            "Pump and Dump": """
📱 *Twitter Thread Going Viral*

Celebrity influencer posts:
"Just bought 50 of these! 🚀🚀🚀
@RandomNFTProject is the next big thing!
Already up 300% - don't miss out!
NFA but I'm going ALL IN! 💎🙌"

The project:
• Launched 3 days ago
• No clear utility
• Website is a single page
• 10% of supply held by 2 wallets
"""
        }
        
        return scenarios.get(pattern.name, scenarios["Rug Pull"])
    
    def evaluate_detection(self, scenario_id: int, user_flags: List[str], user_answer: str) -> Dict:
        """Evaluate user's scam detection ability"""
        
        # Get original scenario
        pattern = next((p for p in self.patterns if p.name == user_answer), None)
        
        if not pattern:
            return {
                'correct': False,
                'score': 0,
                'feedback': "Incorrect scam type identified"
            }
        
        # Check red flags identified
        correct_flags = sum(1 for f in user_flags if f in pattern.red_flags)
        flag_score = correct_flags / len(pattern.red_flags) * 50
        
        # Type identification score
        type_score = 50
        
        total_score = flag_score + type_score
        
        return {
            'correct': True,
            'score': total_score,
            'flags_identified': correct_flags,
            'flags_missed': [f for f in pattern.red_flags if f not in user_flags],
            'feedback': f"Correctly identified as {pattern.name}!",
            'prevention_tips': pattern.prevention_tips
        }


class NFTProjectAnalyzer:
    """Analyze NFT projects for educational purposes"""
    
    def analyze_project(self, project: NFTProject) -> Dict:
        """Analyze an NFT project and provide educational insights"""
        
        analysis = {
            'project': project,
            'risk_assessment': self._assess_risk(project),
            'metrics_explanation': self._explain_metrics(project),
            'red_flags': self._identify_red_flags(project),
            'green_flags': self._identify_green_flags(project),
            'educational_notes': self._generate_educational_notes(project)
        }
        
        return analysis
    
    def _assess_risk(self, project: NFTProject) -> Dict:
        """Assess project risk level"""
        
        risk_score = 0
        factors = []
        
        # Verification status
        if not project.verified:
            risk_score += 2
            factors.append("Not verified on marketplace")
        
        # Age of project
        days_old = (datetime.now() - project.created_at).days
        if days_old < 30:
            risk_score += 2
            factors.append("Project less than 30 days old")
        elif days_old < 90:
            risk_score += 1
            factors.append("Project less than 90 days old")
        
        # Owner concentration
        if project.owners_count < project.items_count * 0.1:
            risk_score += 2
            factors.append("Low holder diversity")
        
        # Social presence
        if not project.twitter or not project.discord:
            risk_score += 1
            factors.append("Limited social media presence")
        
        risk_level = "Low" if risk_score <= 2 else "Medium" if risk_score <= 5 else "High"
        
        return {
            'score': min(risk_score, 10),
            'level': risk_level,
            'factors': factors
        }
    
    def _explain_metrics(self, project: NFTProject) -> Dict:
        """Explain project metrics for learning"""
        
        explanations = {}
        
        if project.floor_price:
            explanations['floor_price'] = {
                'value': float(project.floor_price),
                'explanation': "The lowest price at which an NFT from this collection is currently listed for sale. A rising floor often indicates growing demand."
            }
        
        if project.total_volume:
            explanations['total_volume'] = {
                'value': float(project.total_volume),
                'explanation': "Total value of all trades in this collection. Higher volume suggests more market activity and liquidity."
            }
        
        explanations['owners_count'] = {
            'value': project.owners_count,
            'explanation': f"Number of unique wallets holding NFTs from this collection. With {project.items_count} items and {project.owners_count} owners, the average holder owns {project.items_count/project.owners_count:.1f} items."
        }
        
        return explanations
    
    def _identify_red_flags(self, project: NFTProject) -> List[str]:
        """Identify potential red flags"""
        
        return project.risk_factors
    
    def _identify_green_flags(self, project: NFTProject) -> List[str]:
        """Identify positive signals"""
        
        green_flags = []
        
        if project.verified:
            green_flags.append("✅ Verified on marketplace")
        
        days_old = (datetime.now() - project.created_at).days
        if days_old > 180:
            green_flags.append("✅ Established project (6+ months)")
        
        if project.owners_count > project.items_count * 0.5:
            green_flags.append("✅ Good holder distribution")
        
        if project.twitter and project.discord:
            green_flags.append("✅ Active social presence")
        
        return green_flags
    
    def _generate_educational_notes(self, project: NFTProject) -> List[str]:
        """Generate educational notes about the project"""
        
        notes = []
        
        notes.append(f"This project is on {project.blockchain.value.title()}, which means transactions use {self._get_gas_token(project.blockchain)} for gas fees.")
        
        notes.append(f"The {project.category.value} category includes NFTs that {self._get_category_description(project.category)}")
        
        return notes
    
    def _get_gas_token(self, blockchain: BlockchainNetwork) -> str:
        """Get gas token for blockchain"""
        
        tokens = {
            BlockchainNetwork.ETHEREUM: "ETH",
            BlockchainNetwork.POLYGON: "MATIC",
            BlockchainNetwork.SOLANA: "SOL",
            BlockchainNetwork.BINANCE: "BNB",
            BlockchainNetwork.AVALANCHE: "AVAX"
        }
        return tokens.get(blockchain, "native token")
    
    def _get_category_description(self, category: NFTCategory) -> str:
        """Get category description"""
        
        descriptions = {
            NFTCategory.ART: "represent digital artwork, often one-of-a-kind pieces by artists.",
            NFTCategory.COLLECTIBLES: "are designed to be collected, often with varying rarity traits.",
            NFTCategory.GAMING: "provide in-game assets, characters, or items for blockchain games.",
            NFTCategory.MUSIC: "represent music rights, exclusive tracks, or fan experiences.",
            NFTCategory.VIRTUAL_LAND: "represent ownership of virtual real estate in metaverse platforms."
        }
        return descriptions.get(category, "serve various purposes in the Web3 ecosystem.")


class NFTSimulator:
    """Simulate NFT trading for practice"""
    
    def __init__(self, user_id: int):
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.portfolio = self._get_or_create_portfolio()
    
    def _get_or_create_portfolio(self) -> SimulationPortfolio:
        """Get or create simulation portfolio"""
        
        portfolio = get_simulation_portfolio(self.user_id)
        
        if not portfolio:
            portfolio = SimulationPortfolio(
                id=0,
                user_id=self.user_id,
                starting_balance=Decimal('10'),  # 10 ETH starting
                current_balance=Decimal('10'),
                total_invested=Decimal('0'),
                total_pnl=Decimal('0'),
                holdings=[],
                transactions=[],
                created_at=datetime.now(),
                updated_at=datetime.now()
            )
            portfolio = save_simulation_portfolio(portfolio)
        
        return portfolio
    
    def buy_nft(self, project_id: int, quantity: int, price: Decimal) -> Dict:
        """Simulate buying NFT"""
        
        total_cost = price * quantity
        
        if total_cost > self.portfolio.current_balance:
            return {
                'success': False,
                'error': 'Insufficient balance'
            }
        
        # Update portfolio
        self.portfolio.current_balance -= total_cost
        self.portfolio.total_invested += total_cost
        
        # Add to holdings
        existing = next((h for h in self.portfolio.holdings if h['project_id'] == project_id), None)
        
        if existing:
            # Update average price
            total_qty = existing['quantity'] + quantity
            total_value = existing['avg_price'] * existing['quantity'] + price * quantity
            existing['avg_price'] = total_value / total_qty
            existing['quantity'] = total_qty
        else:
            self.portfolio.holdings.append({
                'project_id': project_id,
                'quantity': quantity,
                'avg_price': float(price),
                'current_value': float(price * quantity)
            })
        
        # Record transaction
        self.portfolio.transactions.append({
            'type': 'buy',
            'project_id': project_id,
            'quantity': quantity,
            'price': float(price),
            'total': float(total_cost),
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
        })
        
        self.portfolio.updated_at = datetime.now()
        save_simulation_portfolio(self.portfolio)
        
        return {
            'success': True,
            'quantity': quantity,
            'price': float(price),
            'total_cost': float(total_cost),
            'remaining_balance': float(self.portfolio.current_balance)
        }
    
    def sell_nft(self, project_id: int, quantity: int, price: Decimal) -> Dict:
        """Simulate selling NFT"""
        
        holding = next((h for h in self.portfolio.holdings if h['project_id'] == project_id), None)
        
        if not holding or holding['quantity'] < quantity:
            return {
                'success': False,
                'error': 'Insufficient NFTs to sell'
            }
        
        total_revenue = price * quantity
        cost_basis = Decimal(str(holding['avg_price'])) * quantity
        pnl = total_revenue - cost_basis
        
        # Update portfolio
        self.portfolio.current_balance += total_revenue
        self.portfolio.total_pnl += pnl
        
        # Update holding
        holding['quantity'] -= quantity
        if holding['quantity'] == 0:
            self.portfolio.holdings.remove(holding)
        
        # Record transaction
        self.portfolio.transactions.append({
            'type': 'sell',
            'project_id': project_id,
            'quantity': quantity,
            'price': float(price),
            'total': float(total_revenue),
            'pnl': float(pnl),
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
        })
        
        self.portfolio.updated_at = datetime.now()
        save_simulation_portfolio(self.portfolio)
        
        return {
            'success': True,
            'quantity': quantity,
            'price': float(price),
            'total_revenue': float(total_revenue),
            'pnl': float(pnl),
            'remaining_balance': float(self.portfolio.current_balance)
        }
    
    def get_portfolio_summary(self) -> Dict:
        """Get portfolio summary"""
        
        total_holdings_value = Decimal('0')
        
        for holding in self.portfolio.holdings:
            # Get current price (would fetch real data)
            project = get_nft_project(holding['project_id'])
            current_price = project.floor_price if project else Decimal(str(holding['avg_price']))
            
            holding['current_price'] = float(current_price)
            holding['current_value'] = float(current_price * holding['quantity'])
            holding['pnl'] = holding['current_value'] - (holding['avg_price'] * holding['quantity'])
            holding['pnl_pct'] = (holding['pnl'] / (holding['avg_price'] * holding['quantity']) * 100) if holding['avg_price'] > 0 else 0
            
            total_holdings_value += Decimal(str(holding['current_value']))
        
        total_value = self.portfolio.current_balance + total_holdings_value
        total_return = total_value - self.portfolio.starting_balance
        total_return_pct = float(total_return / self.portfolio.starting_balance * 100)
        
        return {
            'starting_balance': float(self.portfolio.starting_balance),
            'current_balance': float(self.portfolio.current_balance),
            'holdings_value': float(total_holdings_value),
            'total_value': float(total_value),
            'total_return': float(total_return),
            'total_return_pct': total_return_pct,
            'holdings': self.portfolio.holdings,
            'transaction_count': len(self.portfolio.transactions)
        }
```

class LessonContentGenerator:

# What is Blockchain?

A **blockchain** is a distributed digital ledger that records transactions across many computers.

## 🔑 Key Concepts

### Decentralization
Unlike traditional databases controlled by one entity, blockchain is maintained by thousands of computers (nodes) worldwide.

```
Traditional Database:
[Central Server] ← All users connect here

Blockchain:
[Node 1] ↔ [Node 2] ↔ [Node 3]
    ↕         ↕         ↕
[Node 4] ↔ [Node 5] ↔ [Node 6]
```

### Immutability
Once data is recorded, it cannot be changed or deleted. Each block contains:
- Transaction data
- Timestamp
- Hash of previous block (creates the "chain")

### Transparency
All transactions are visible to anyone on the network.

## 🤔 Why Does This Matter for NFTs?

NFTs use blockchain to:
1. **Prove ownership** - Recorded permanently on-chain
2. **Verify authenticity** - Can trace back to original creator
3. **Enable trading** - Trustless peer-to-peer transactions

## ⚡ Quick Facts

| Feature | Traditional Database | Blockchain |
|---------|---------------------|------------|
| Control | Centralized | Decentralized |
| Data Changes | Can be modified | Immutable |
| Trust | Trust the company | Trust the code |
| Downtime | Single point of failure | Always running |
""",
                'key_concepts': ['Decentralization', 'Immutability', 'Transparency', 'Distributed Ledger'],
                'duration': 8,
                'points': 15
            },
            {
                'title': 'Understanding Wallets',
                'content': """
# Crypto Wallets Explained

A **crypto wallet** is your gateway to the blockchain. It doesn't actually store your NFTs or crypto – it stores your **keys** that prove you own them.

## 🔐 Keys Explained

### Public Key (Address)
- Like your email address
- Safe to share
- Used to receive NFTs and crypto
- Example: `0x1234...abcd`

### Private Key
- Like your password
- **NEVER share this!**
- Controls your entire wallet
- Lose it = lose everything

### Seed Phrase (Recovery Phrase)
- 12-24 random words
- Backup for your private key
- Store offline, never digitally
- Example: "apple banana cherry..."

## 🛡️ CRITICAL SECURITY RULES

```
⚠️ NEVER:
❌ Share your seed phrase
❌ Enter it on websites
❌ Store it in cloud/email
❌ Take screenshots of it

✅ ALWAYS:
✓ Write it on paper
✓ Store in multiple secure locations
✓ Verify you copied it correctly
```

## 💼 Types of Wallets

### Hot Wallets (Connected to Internet)
- **MetaMask** - Browser extension, beginner friendly
- **Phantom** - Best for Solana
- **Trust Wallet** - Mobile-focused

✅ Convenient for daily use
❌ More vulnerable to hacks

### Cold Wallets (Hardware)
- **Ledger** - Industry standard
- **Trezor** - Open source option

✅ Maximum security
❌ Less convenient, costs money

## 🎯 Best Practice

Use BOTH:
- Hot wallet for small amounts & daily trading
- Cold wallet for valuable NFTs & long-term holds
""",
                'key_concepts': ['Public Key', 'Private Key', 'Seed Phrase', 'Hot Wallet', 'Cold Wallet'],

                'title': 'Gas Fees Explained',
                'content': """
# Understanding Gas Fees

**Gas** is the fee you pay to use the blockchain. Think of it like postage for sending a letter.

## ⛽ What is Gas?

When you:
- Mint an NFT
- Transfer an NFT
- Buy/sell on marketplace
- Interact with smart contracts

...you need to pay gas to the network validators who process your transaction.

## 📊 Gas Components

### On Ethereum:

```
Total Fee = Gas Limit × Gas Price

Gas Limit: Amount of computational work
Gas Price: Cost per unit (in Gwei)
1 Gwei = 0.000000001 ETH
```

### Example:
- Simple transfer: ~21,000 gas
- NFT mint: ~100,000-200,000 gas
- Complex swap: ~200,000+ gas

## 💡 Tips to Save on Gas

1. **Time your transactions**
   - Weekends often cheaper
   - Early morning (US time) usually lower

2. **Use gas tracking tools**
   - etherscan.io/gastracker
   - gasnow.org

3. **Set custom gas limit**
   - Don't overpay
   - But too low = failed transaction

4. **Consider Layer 2 solutions**
   - Polygon: ~$0.01 per transaction
   - Arbitrum: Significant savings
   - Optimism: Fast and cheap

## 🔗 Gas by Network

| Network | Typical Cost | Speed |
|---------|--------------|-------|
| Ethereum | $5-100+ | ~15 sec |
| Polygon | $0.01-0.10 | ~2 sec |
| Solana | $0.00025 | ~0.4 sec |
| Binance | $0.10-0.50 | ~3 sec |

## ⚠️ Common Mistakes

❌ Setting gas too low (transaction fails, still lose gas)
❌ Trading during network congestion
❌ Not checking gas before confirming
❌ Forgetting about gas when budgeting
""",
                'key_concepts': ['Gas', 'Gwei', 'Gas Limit', 'Gas Price', 'Layer 2'],
                'duration': 10,
                'points': 20
            }
        ]

                'title': 'What are NFTs?',
                'content': """
# What are NFTs?

**NFT** stands for **Non-Fungible Token**.

## 🔄 Fungible vs Non-Fungible

### Fungible (Interchangeable)
- 1 Bitcoin = 1 Bitcoin
- 1 Dollar = 1 Dollar
- Any unit is the same as another

### Non-Fungible (Unique)
- Each token is one-of-a-kind
- Cannot be exchanged 1:1
- Has unique properties and value

## 🎨 What Makes NFTs Special?

### 1. Proof of Ownership
The blockchain proves you own the original, not just a copy.

### 2. Provenance
Complete history of ownership is recorded forever.

### 3. Programmable
Smart contracts can include:
- Royalties (creators earn on every resale)
- Unlockable content
- Access rights

## 📦 What Can Be an NFT?

```
🎨 Digital Art
🎵 Music & Audio
🎮 Gaming Items
🏠 Virtual Real Estate
📸 Photography
🎫 Event Tickets
📜 Documents & Certificates
🌐 Domain Names
```

## 🧠 Common Misconceptions

| Myth | Reality |
|------|---------|
| "I can just screenshot it" | You own the image, not the token |
| "NFTs are just JPEGs" | The token proves ownership & can have utility |
| "NFTs are bad for environment" | Many use eco-friendly blockchains now |
| "NFTs are worthless" | Value is determined by market, like all assets |

## 💡 Key Insight

Owning an NFT is like owning an original painting:
- Others can have prints (copies)
- Only you have the verified original
- The blockchain is your certificate of authenticity
""",
                'key_concepts': ['Non-Fungible', 'Token', 'Ownership', 'Provenance', 'Smart Contract'],
                'duration': 10,
                'points': 15
            },
            {
                'title': 'NFT Metadata and Traits',
                'content': """
# Understanding NFT Metadata

Every NFT has **metadata** - information that describes the token and makes it unique.

## 📋 What's in NFT Metadata?

```json
{
  "name": "Cool Cat #1234",
  "description": "A unique Cool Cat",
  "image": "ipfs://Qm...",
  "attributes": [
    {"trait_type": "Background", "value": "Blue"},
    {"trait_type": "Fur", "value": "Gold"},
    {"trait_type": "Eyes", "value": "Laser"}
  ]
}
```

## 🎲 Traits and Rarity

### How Rarity Works

Each trait has a percentage based on how common it is:

| Trait | Count | Rarity |
|-------|-------|--------|
| Gold Fur | 50/10,000 | 0.5% (Rare!) |
| Blue Background | 2,000/10,000 | 20% (Common) |
| Laser Eyes | 100/10,000 | 1% (Rare!) |

### Rarity Score

Combine trait rarities for overall rarity:
```
Rarity Score = 1/trait1% + 1/trait2% + 1/trait3%...
```

Higher score = Rarer NFT = Often more valuable

## 🔍 Where is Metadata Stored?

### On-Chain
- Stored directly on blockchain
- Most permanent and secure
- More expensive

### Off-Chain (IPFS)
- Stored on decentralized file network
- Common for images
- Still permanent if pinned

### Centralized Server
- Stored on regular servers
- ⚠️ Risk: Server goes down = metadata lost

## 🛠️ Rarity Tools

Popular tools to check rarity:
- **Rarity.tools** - Ethereum collections
- **HowRare.is** - Solana collections
- **Trait Sniper** - Multi-chain

## ⚠️ Important Notes

1. Rarity doesn't always equal value
2. Some traits become valuable due to culture/memes
3. Utility traits may be more valuable than rare cosmetics
4. Always verify metadata sources
""",
                'key_concepts': ['Metadata', 'Traits', 'Rarity', 'IPFS', 'Attributes'],
                'duration': 12,
                'points': 20
            }
        ]

                'content': """
# How to Spot NFT Scams

The NFT space has many opportunities, but also many scammers. Learn to protect yourself.

## 🚨 Top 5 Scam Types

### 1. Rug Pulls
Creators abandon project after collecting funds.

**Red Flags:**
- Anonymous team
- No clear roadmap
- Unrealistic promises
- Rushing to buy

### 2. Phishing
Fake websites stealing your wallet.

**Red Flags:**
- DMs asking to connect wallet
- URLs slightly misspelled
- Requests for seed phrase

### 3. Fake Collections
Counterfeit versions of popular NFTs.

**Red Flags:**
- Not verified ✓
- Lower than normal prices
- Different contract address

### 4. Pump & Dump
Coordinated buying then dumping.

**Red Flags:**
- Aggressive promotion
- Sudden price spikes
- Celebrity endorsements

### 5. Wallet Drainers
Malicious smart contracts that steal assets.

**Red Flags:**
- Asking to "claim" free NFTs
- Suspicious transaction approvals
- Unknown website requests

## 🛡️ Protection Checklist

```
Before buying:
□ Research the team (doxxed?)
□ Check contract (audited?)
□ Verify on official channels
□ Look at holder distribution
□ Read community sentiment
□ Check trading patterns

Before connecting wallet:
□ Verify website URL character by character
□ Check if site is bookmarked/official
□ Use burner wallet for unknown sites
□ Review transaction permissions
```

## 🔒 Security Best Practices

1. **Use multiple wallets**
   - Main wallet: Only for trusted interactions
   - Burner wallet: For new/unknown sites

2. **Revoke permissions regularly**
   - revoke.cash
   - etherscan.io/tokenapprovalchecker

3. **Enable hardware wallet**
   - Extra confirmation for transactions
   - Physical verification required

4. **Stay skeptical**
   - If it seems too good to be true, it is
   - FOMO is your enemy
""",
                'key_concepts': ['Rug Pull', 'Phishing', 'Fake Collections', 'Pump & Dump', 'Wallet Security'],
                'duration': 15,

            }

async def handle_scam_answer(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    """Handle scam training answer"""
    
    query = update.callback_query
    
    user_answer = query.data.replace("scam_answer_", "")
    scenario = context.user_data.get('scam_scenario')
    
    if not scenario:
        await query.answer("Session expired")
        return
    
    is_correct = user_answer == scenario['correct_answer']
    
    if is_correct:
        await query.answer("✅ Correct!")
        message = "✅ *Correct!*\n\n"
    else:
        await query.answer("❌ Incorrect")
        message = f"❌ *Incorrect*\n\nThis was a *{scenario['correct_answer']}*\n\n"

# Idea #60: P2P Lending Bot

## 📋 Concept Overview

A Telegram bot that facilitates peer-to-peer lending between users, allowing people to lend and borrow small amounts directly from each other with proper documentation and tracking.

## 😫 Problems It Solves

- Banks don't give small loans easily
- High interest rates from traditional lenders
- No platform for trusted community lending
- Informal loans lack documentation
- Difficulty tracking repayments

## ⭐ Key Features

```
Phase 1 (Week 1-4):
├── User verification & KYC
├── Loan request posting
├── Lender matching system
├── Digital contract generation
├── Payment schedule tracking
├── Reminder notifications
└── Dispute resolution basics

Phase 2 (Week 5-8):
├── Credit scoring system
├── Collateral management
├── Escrow service integration
├── Social proof (references)
├── Insurance options
├── Secondary market (sell loans)
└── Analytics dashboard
```

## 👨‍💻 Complete Implementation

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, date
from typing import List, Optional, Dict

from enum import Enum

class UserVerificationStatus(Enum):
    UNVERIFIED = "unverified"
    PENDING = "pending"

    REJECTED = "rejected"

class LoanRequestStatus(Enum):
    OPEN = "open"
    FUNDED = "funded"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    DEFAULTED = "defaulted"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"

class PaymentStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    PAID = "paid"
    OVERDUE = "overdue"
    PARTIAL = "partial"

@dataclass
class UserProfile:
    id: int
    telegram_id: int
    full_name: str
    national_id: str  # کد ملی - encrypted
    phone: str

    credit_score: int  # 300-850

    total_lent: Decimal
    successful_loans: int
    defaulted_loans: int
    joined_at: datetime
    last_active: datetime

@dataclass
class LoanRequest:
    id: int
    borrower_id: int
    amount: Decimal
    purpose: str

    duration_months: int

class LoanOffer:
